name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.productBump_iteratedFDeriv_bounded
statement:
theorem productBump_iteratedFDeriv_bounded {d : ℕ} (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (productBump (d := d)) x‖ ≤ C

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.productBump_zero
statement: theorem productBump_zero {d : ℕ} : productBump (d := d) 0 = 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledProductBump_contDiff
statement:
theorem scaledProductBump_contDiff {d : ℕ} (β h : ℝ)
    (x₀ : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (scaledProductBump β h x₀)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledProductBump_eq_coordinate_div
statement:
theorem scaledProductBump_eq_coordinate_div {d : ℕ} (β : ℝ)
    {h : ℝ} (_hh : h ≠ 0) (x₀ x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    scaledProductBump β h x₀ x =
      h ^ β * productBump (fun i => (x i - x₀ i) / h)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledProductBump_iteratedFDeriv
statement:
theorem scaledProductBump_iteratedFDeriv {d : ℕ} (j : ℕ)
    (β h : ℝ) (x₀ x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (scaledProductBump β h x₀) x =
      (h ^ β) • ((h⁻¹) ^ j •
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (productBump (d := d)) (h⁻¹ • (x - x₀)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_contDiff
statement:
theorem scaledCopy_contDiff (β h : ℝ) (z : E) {f : E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (scaledCopy β h z f)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_fderiv
statement:
theorem scaledCopy_fderiv (β h : ℝ) (z x : E) {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hh : 0 < h) :
    fderiv ℝ (scaledCopy β h z f) x =
      (h ^ β * h⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ f (h⁻¹ • (x - z))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_iteratedFDeriv
statement:
-- Restrict hf to the finite natural order j using hj (casts into WithTop ℕ∞).
-- These Mathlib identities include j=0 and h=0; this theorem deliberately
-- imposes neither a positive bandwidth nor an infinite-order smoothness premise.
theorem scaledCopy_iteratedFDeriv (β h : ℝ) (z x : E) {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (scaledCopy β h z f) x =
      (h ^ β) • ((h⁻¹) ^ j • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (h⁻¹ • (x - z)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_jets_zero
statement:
theorem scaledCopy_jets_zero (β h : ℝ) (z : E) {f : E → ℝ} {K : Set E}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, f x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x = 0)
    (x : E) (hx : x ∉ scaledSupport h z K) :
    scaledCopy β h z f x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (scaledCopy β h z f) x = 0 ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (scaledCopy β h z f)) x = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_second_fderiv
statement:
-- First prove scaledCopy_fderiv as an equality of functions (funext).
-- Differentiate that identity using C¹ regularity of fderiv f from hf.
-- Constant scalar dilation contributes another h⁻¹; no third derivative is needed.
theorem scaledCopy_second_fderiv (β h : ℝ) (z x : E) {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hh : 0 < h) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (scaledCopy β h z f)) x =
      (h ^ β * (h⁻¹) ^ 2) • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (h⁻¹ • (x - z))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_global_holder_extension_zero
statement:
theorem exists_global_holder_extension_zero (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin 0 → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
        CubeHolderBall 0 m s L u →
        ∃ U : (Fin 0 → ℝ) → ℝ,
          Set.EqOn U u (cube 0) ∧
          ContDiff ℝ m U ∧
          (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j U x‖ ≤ A * L) ∧
          (∀ x y,
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m U x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m U y‖
              ≤ A * L * ‖x - y‖ ^ s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_global_holder_extension_order_zero
statement:
theorem exists_global_holder_extension_order_zero (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
        CubeHolderBall d 0 s L u →
        ∃ U : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ,
          Set.EqOn U u (cube d) ∧
          ContDiff ℝ 0 U ∧
          (∀ j ≤ 0, ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j U x‖ ≤ A * L) ∧
          (∀ x y,
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 U x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 U y‖
              ≤ A * L * ‖x - y‖ ^ s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.affine_coordPartial
statement:
theorem affine_coordPartial {d j : ℕ} (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (f : Fin j → Fin d) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    coordPartial j (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f x =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ j * coordPartial j u f (cubeAffine x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.affine_holderBall
statement:
theorem affine_holderBall {d m : ℕ} {s R : ℝ} (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hu : HolderBall d m s R u) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) (unitCube d) ∧
    (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ f : Fin j → Fin d, ∀ x ∈ unitCube d,
      |coordPartial j (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f x| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ j * R) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin m → Fin d, ∀ x ∈ unitCube d, ∀ y ∈ unitCube d,
      |coordPartial m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f x -
        coordPartial m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f y| ≤
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((m : ℝ) + s) * R) * ‖x - y‖ ^ s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.affine_topHolder
statement:
theorem affine_topHolder {d m : ℕ} {s L : ℝ} (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d)) (hL : TopHolder d m s L u) :
    ∀ f : Fin m → Fin d, ∀ x ∈ unitCube d, ∀ y ∈ unitCube d,
      |coordPartial m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f x -
        coordPartial m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f y| ≤
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((m : ℝ) + s) * L) * ‖x - y‖ ^ s

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.sum_coordCount
statement:
theorem sum_coordCount {d m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → Fin d) :
    (∑ i : Fin d, coordCount f i) = m

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.euclidean_to_topHolder
statement:
theorem euclidean_to_topHolder (d m : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ),
        0 ≤ L →
        (∀ f : Fin m → Fin d, ∀ x ∈ cube d, ∀ y ∈ cube d,
          |coordPartial m u f x - coordPartial m u f y| ≤
            L * euclideanDistance x y ^ s) →
        TopHolder d m s (C * L) u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.factorJet_abs_le_four
statement:
theorem factorJet_abs_le_four (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : FactorBoundsAt I J a u) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ I) (p q : ℕ) :
    |factorJet J i p q a u| ≤ 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm_abs_le
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm_abs_le (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (xs ys : List ι) (a u : ℝ) (h : FactorBoundsAt I J a u)
    (hxs : xs.length ≤ 2) (hys : ys.length ≤ 2) :
    |leibnizTerm I J xs ys a u| ≤ 256 * (2 : ℝ) ^ I.card

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.productJet22_abs_le
statement:
theorem productJet22_abs_le (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : FactorBoundsAt I J a u) :
    |productJet22 I J a u| ≤
      256 * (I.card : ℝ) ^ 4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ I.card

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.productJet22_abs_le_on_rectangle
statement:
theorem productJet22_abs_le_on_rectangle (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (a₀ a₁ u₀ u₁ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc a₀ a₁, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc u₀ u₁, FactorBoundsAt I J a u) :
    ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc a₀ a₁, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc u₀ u₁,
      |productJet22 I J a u| ≤
        256 * (I.card : ℝ) ^ 4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ I.card

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_factorJet_a
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_factorJet_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : AChainsAt I J a u) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ I) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => factorJet J i p 0 b u)
      (factorJet J i (p + 1) 0 a u) a

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_factorJet_u
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_factorJet_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : UChainsAt I J a u) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ I)
    (p q : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ 2) (hq : q ≤ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => factorJet J i p q a v)
      (factorJet J i p (q + 1) a u) u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_leibnizTerm_a
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_leibnizTerm_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (xs : List ι) (a u : ℝ) (h : AChainsAt I J a u) (hlen : xs.length ≤ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => leibnizTerm I J xs [] b u)
      (∑ k ∈ I, leibnizTerm I J (k :: xs) [] a u) a

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_leibnizTerm_u
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_leibnizTerm_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (xs ys : List ι) (a u : ℝ) (h : UChainsAt I J a u)
    (hxs : xs.length ≤ 2) (hys : ys.length ≤ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => leibnizTerm I J xs ys a v)
      (∑ k ∈ I, leibnizTerm I J xs (k :: ys) a u) u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_productJet10_a
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_productJet10_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : AChainsAt I J a u) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => productJet10 I J b u) (productJet20 I J a u) a

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_productJet20_u
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_productJet20_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : UChainsAt I J a u) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => productJet20 I J a v) (productJet21 I J a u) u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_productJet21_u
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_productJet21_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : UChainsAt I J a u) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_product_a

theorem hasDerivAt_product_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : AChainsAt I J a u) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm_cons_a
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm_cons_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (xs ys : List ι)
    (k : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hk : k ∈ I) :
    leibnizTerm I J (k :: xs) ys a u =
      factorJet J k (xs.count k + 1) (ys.count k) a u *
        ∏ i ∈ I.erase k, factorJet J i (xs.count i) (ys.count i) a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm_cons_u
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm_cons_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (xs ys : List ι)
    (k : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hk : k ∈ I) :
    leibnizTerm I J xs (k :: ys) a u =
      factorJet J k (xs.count k) (ys.count k + 1) a u *
        ∏ i ∈ I.erase k, factorJet J i (xs.count i) (ys.count i) a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm22_all_same
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm22_all_same (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (r : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ I) :
    leibnizTerm I J [r, r] [r, r] a u =
      J.f22 r a u * ∏ i ∈ I.erase r, J.f00 i a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm22_repeated_u_zero
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm22_repeated_u_zero (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (p q r : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ I) (hnot : p ≠ r ∨ q ≠ r) :
    leibnizTerm I J [p, q] [r, r] a u = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm22_vanishes_outside
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm22_vanishes_outside (I M : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (p q r s : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ I) (hs : s ∈ I)
    (hzero : ∀ i ∈ I, i ∉ M →
      J.f01 i a u = 0 ∧ J.f11 i a u = 0 ∧
        J.f21 i a u = 0 ∧ J.f22 i a u = 0)
    (houtside : r ∉ M ∨ s ∉ M) :
    leibnizTerm I J [p, q] [r, s] a u = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.mem_secondSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_secondSupport_iff (ys : List ι) (i : ι) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.productJet20_eq_diagonal_add_offDiagonal
statement:
theorem productJet20_eq_diagonal_add_offDiagonal (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (a u : ℝ) :
    productJet20 I J a u =
      (∑ i ∈ I, J.f20 i a u * ∏ k ∈ I.erase i, J.f00 k a u) +
      ∑ i ∈ I, ∑ j ∈ I.erase i,
        J.f10 i a u * J.f10 j a u *
          ∏ k ∈ (I.erase i).erase j, J.f00 k a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.productJet22_support_decomposition
statement:
theorem productJet22_support_decomposition (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (a u : ℝ) :
    productJet22 I J a u =
      (∑ r ∈ I, J.f22 r a u * ∏ i ∈ I.erase r, J.f00 i a u) +
      ∑ p ∈ I, ∑ q ∈ I, ∑ r ∈ I, ∑ s ∈ I.erase r,
        leibnizTerm I J [p, q] [r, s] a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.secondSupport_pair

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.holderDerivOrder_lt
statement: lemma holderDerivOrder_lt {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) : (holderDerivOrder β : ℝ) < β

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.holder_taylor_remainder
statement:
theorem holder_taylor_remainder {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M β lo hi t a : ℝ}
    (hβ : 0 < β) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc lo hi) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc lo hi)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ((holderDerivOrder β)) f)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc lo hi,
            |iteratedDeriv (holderDerivOrder β) f x - iteratedDeriv (holderDerivOrder β) f y|
              ≤ M * |x - y| ^ (β - ((holderDerivOrder β) : ℝ))) :
    |f a - taylorPoly (holderDerivOrder β) f t a|
      ≤ M / ((holderDerivOrder β)).factorial * |a - t| ^ β

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.holder_taylor_remainder_of_lt
statement:
lemma holder_taylor_remainder_of_lt {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M β lo hi t a : ℝ} {p : ℕ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc lo hi) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc lo hi)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ p f)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc lo hi,
            |iteratedDeriv p f x - iteratedDeriv p f y|
              ≤ M * |x - y| ^ (β - (p : ℝ)))
    (hp_pos : 0 < p) (hp_le_beta : (p : ℝ) ≤ β) (hlt : t < a) :
    |f a - taylorPoly p f t a| ≤ M / (p.factorial : ℝ) * |a - t| ^ β

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.taylorPoly_eval_base
statement: theorem taylorPoly_eval_base (p : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : taylorPoly p f t t = f t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.taylorPoly_reflect
statement:
lemma taylorPoly_reflect (p : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t a : ℝ) :
    taylorPoly p (fun x => f (2 * t - x)) t (2 * t - a) = taylorPoly p f t a

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.taylorPoly_succ
statement:
lemma taylorPoly_succ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t a : ℝ) :
    taylorPoly (n + 1) f t a =
      taylorPoly n f t a
        + iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f t / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (a - t) ^ (n + 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.taylorWithinEval_eq_taylorPoly
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.affine_cube_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem affine_cube_contDiffOn
    (k : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ k
      (fun z : Fin 1 → ℝ => f (a + d / 2 + (d / 2) * z 0))
      (cube 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.affine_cube_coordJetOn
statement:
theorem affine_cube_coordJetOn
    (j : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ j f (Set.Icc a (a + d)))
    (q : Fin j → Fin 1) (z : Fin 1 → ℝ) (hz : z ∈ cube 1) :
    coordJetOn (cube 1) j
      (fun w : Fin 1 → ℝ => f (a + d / 2 + (d / 2) * w 0)) q z =
      (d / 2) ^ j *
        iteratedDerivWithin j f (Set.Icc a (a + d))
          (a + d / 2 + (d / 2) * z 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.affine_cube_topHolderOn
statement:
theorem affine_cube_topHolderOn
    (k : ℕ) (α a d L : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)))
    (hholder : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      |iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) x -
        iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) y| ≤
          L * |x - y| ^ α) :
    TopHolderOn (cube 1) k α
      (L * (d / 2) ^ k * (d / 2) ^ α)
      (fun z : Fin 1 → ℝ => f (a + d / 2 + (d / 2) * z 0))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.within_jet_bound_of_interior_ambient_bound
statement:
theorem within_jet_bound_of_interior_ambient_bound
    (k : ℕ) (a b B : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hinterior : ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
      |iteratedDeriv j f x| ≤ B) :
    ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b,
      |iteratedDerivWithin j f (Set.Icc a b) x| ≤ B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.endpoint_holder_taylor
statement:
theorem endpoint_holder_taylor
    (k : ℕ) (α d L : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) →
        (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
          |iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) x -
            iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) y| ≤
              L * |x - y| ^ α) →
        ∃ coeff : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ,
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
            |f t - ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), coeff j * (a + d - t) ^ j.val| ≤
              C * (a + d - t) ^ ((k : ℝ) + α)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.endpoint_holder_taylor_Icc
statement:
theorem endpoint_holder_taylor_Icc
    (k : ℕ) (α a b L : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hab : a < b) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a b) →
        (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b,
          |iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a b) x -
            iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a b) y| ≤
              L * |x - y| ^ α) →
        ∃ coeff : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ,
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
            |f t - ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), coeff j * (b - t) ^ j.val| ≤
              C * (b - t) ^ ((k : ℝ) + α)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.lower_jet_holder_of_next_bound
statement:
theorem lower_jet_holder_of_next_bound
    (j : ℕ) (α a d B : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (j + 1) f (Set.Icc a (a + d)))
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      |iteratedDerivWithin (j + 1) f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t| ≤ B) :
    ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      |iteratedDerivWithin j f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) x -
        iteratedDerivWithin j f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) y| ≤
          (B * d ^ (1 - α)) * |x - y| ^ α

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.interval_primitive_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem interval_primitive_contDiffOn
    (k : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ k h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ (k + 1) (fun t : ℝ => ∫ x in a..t, h x)
      (Set.Icc a (a + d))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.interval_primitive_derivWithin
statement:
theorem interval_primitive_derivWithin
    (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ 0 h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      derivWithin (fun u : ℝ => ∫ x in a..u, h x)
        (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t = h t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.interval_primitive_iteratedDerivWithin_succ
statement:
theorem interval_primitive_iteratedDerivWithin_succ
    (k : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ k h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      iteratedDerivWithin (j + 1) (fun u : ℝ => ∫ x in a..u, h x)
        (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t =
      iteratedDerivWithin j h (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.survival_derivWithin
statement:
theorem survival_derivWithin
    (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ 0 h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      derivWithin (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..u, h x)))
        (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t =
      -h t * Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..t, h x))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.survival_iteratedDerivWithin_succ
statement:
theorem survival_iteratedDerivWithin_succ
    (k : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ k h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      iteratedDerivWithin (j + 1)
        (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..u, h x)))
        (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t =
      -(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
          (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) *
            iteratedDerivWithin i h (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t *
            iteratedDerivWithin (j - i)
              (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..u, h x)))
              (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.survival_jet_bound_of_integrand_jet_bound
statement:
theorem survival_jet_bound_of_integrand_jet_bound
    (k : ℕ) (d C E : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hE : 0 ≤ E) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ (a : ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k h (Set.Icc a (a + d)) →
        (∀ j ≤ k, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
          |iteratedDerivWithin j h (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t| ≤ C) →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
          |Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..t, h x))| ≤ E) →
        ∀ j ≤ k + 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
          |iteratedDerivWithin j
            (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..u, h x)))
            (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t| ≤ B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.fourth_rectangular_remainder_bound
statement:
lemma fourth_rectangular_remainder_bound
    (F Fa Faa FaaU FaaUU : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a u B : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hFa : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, HasDerivAt (fun t => F t u) (Fa b u) b)
    (hFaa : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, HasDerivAt (fun t => Fa t u) (Faa b u) b)
    (hFaaU : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, ∀ v ∈ Icc 0 u,
      HasDerivAt (Faa b) (FaaU b v) v)
    (hFaaUU : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, ∀ v ∈ Icc 0 u,
      HasDerivAt (FaaU b) (FaaUU b v) v)
    (hbound : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, ∀ v ∈ Icc 0 u, |FaaUU b v| ≤ B)
    (hF0 : F 0 u = 0) (hFa0 : Fa 0 u = 0)
    (hFaa0 : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, Faa b 0 = 0)
    (hFaaU0 : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, FaaU b 0 = 0) :
    |F a u| ≤ B*a^2*u^2/4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.quadratic_remainder_bound
statement:
lemma quadratic_remainder_bound (f f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (a B : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 a, HasDerivAt f (f₁ x) x)
    (hf₁ : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 a, HasDerivAt f₁ (f₂ x) x)
    (hf₂ : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 a, |f₂ x| ≤ B) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (h10 : f₁ 0 = 0) :
    |f a| ≤ B*a^2/2

statement:
theorem abs_anchorEval_applyFunction_sub_le {n : ℕ} {A B : RectMatrix n n}
    (DA : RealDiagonalization A) (DB : RealDiagonalization B)
    (a b c d : Euc n) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : LipschitzWith 1 f) (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    {κA κB R : ℝ} (hκA : DA.conditionNumber ≤ κA)
    (hκB : DB.conditionNumber ≤ κB) (hR0 : 0 ≤ R)
    (hRA : DA.SpectrumBound R)
    (hRB : DB.SpectrumBound R) :

      ‖a - b‖ * (κA * R) * ‖c‖ +
      ‖b‖ * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * κA * κB * ‖A - B‖) * ‖c‖ +
      ‖b‖ * (κB * R) * ‖c - d‖

theorem applyFunction_sub_eq_dividedDifference {n : ℕ} {A B : RectMatrix n n}

statement:
theorem centered_le_of_differential_inequality
    {ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hψ0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ 0)
    (hψ : ∀ x, 0 < x → a * x < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x)
    (hzero : ψ 0 = 0)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hdiff : ∀ x, 0 < x → a * x < 1 →
      x * (1 - a * x) * deriv ψ x - ψ x ≤ b * x ^ 2)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam : a * lam < 1) :
    ψ lam - lam * deriv ψ 0 ≤
      (a * deriv ψ 0 + b) * lam ^ 2 / (1 - a * lam)

theorem inverse_plancherel (G : ℝ → ℂ) (hcont : Continuous G)
    (hG : Integrable G) (hinv : Integrable (𝓕⁻ G)) :
    Integrable (fun ξ => ‖G ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
    Integrable (fun v => ‖𝓕⁻ G v‖ ^ 2) ∧ energy (𝓕⁻ G) = energy G

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.abs_rpow_le_scaled_quadratic
statement:
theorem abs_rpow_le_scaled_quadratic (κ h v : ℝ)
    (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) (hh : 0 < h) :
    |v| ^ κ ≤ h ^ κ + h ^ (κ - 2) * v ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.integrable_weightedEnergy
statement:
theorem integrable_weightedEnergy (g : ℝ → ℂ) (κ : ℝ)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2)
    (h0 : Integrable (fun v => ‖g v‖ ^ 2))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun v => v ^ 2 * ‖g v‖ ^ 2)) :
    Integrable (fun v => |v| ^ κ * ‖g v‖ ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.weightedEnergy_le_interpolation
statement:
theorem weightedEnergy_le_interpolation (g : ℝ → ℂ) (κ : ℝ)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2)
    (h0 : Integrable (fun v => ‖g v‖ ^ 2))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun v => v ^ 2 * ‖g v‖ ^ 2)) :
    weightedEnergy κ g ≤
      (energy g) ^ (1 - κ / 2) * (weightedEnergy 2 g) ^ (κ / 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.weightedEnergy_le_scaled
statement:
theorem weightedEnergy_le_scaled (g : ℝ → ℂ) (κ h : ℝ)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) (hh : 0 < h)
    (h0 : Integrable (fun v => ‖g v‖ ^ 2))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun v => v ^ 2 * ‖g v‖ ^ 2)) :
    weightedEnergy κ g ≤ h ^ κ * energy g + h ^ (κ - 2) * weightedEnergy 2 g

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverse_weightedEnergy_le
statement:
theorem inverse_weightedEnergy_le (G : ℝ → ℂ) (hG : CompactInverseData G)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) :
    Integrable (fun v => |v| ^ κ * ‖𝓕⁻ G v‖ ^ 2) ∧
    weightedEnergy κ (𝓕⁻ G) ≤
      (energy G) ^ (1 - κ / 2) *
        ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ ^ 2 * energy (deriv G)) ^ (κ / 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverse_weightedEnergy_le_scaled
statement:
theorem inverse_weightedEnergy_le_scaled (G : ℝ → ℂ) (hG : CompactInverseData G)
    (κ h : ℝ) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) (hh : 0 < h) :
    weightedEnergy κ (𝓕⁻ G) ≤
      h ^ κ * energy G + h ^ (κ - 2) * (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ ^ 2 * energy (deriv G)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverseGaussian_deriv_energy_le
statement:
theorem inverseGaussian_deriv_energy_le (F : ℝ → ℂ) (σ h a b : ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F) (hh : 0 < h) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hsupport : Function.support F ⊆ Icc (-(3 / (Real.pi * h))) (3 / (Real.pi * h)))
    (hbound : ∀ ξ, ‖F ξ‖ ≤ a * h) (hderiv : ∀ ξ, ‖deriv F ξ‖ ≤ b * h ^ 2) :
    energy (deriv (inverseGaussian σ F)) ≤
      (6 / Real.pi) * (b + 12 * Real.pi * a) ^ 2 * h ^ 3 *
        (1 + σ / h) ^ 4 * Real.exp (36 * (σ / h) ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverseGaussian_energy_le
statement:

    (hsupport : Function.support F ⊆ Icc (-(3 / (Real.pi * h))) (3 / (Real.pi * h)))
    (hbound : ∀ ξ, ‖F ξ‖ ≤ a * h) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverseGaussian_weightedEnergy_le
statement:
theorem inverseGaussian_weightedEnergy_le (F : ℝ → ℂ) (κ σ h a b : ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport F)
    (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) (hh : 0 < h) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hsupport : Function.support F ⊆ Icc (-(3 / (Real.pi * h))) (3 / (Real.pi * h)))
    (hbound : ∀ ξ, ‖F ξ‖ ≤ a * h) (hderiv : ∀ ξ, ‖deriv F ξ‖ ≤ b * h ^ 2)
    (hinv : Integrable (𝓕⁻ (inverseGaussian σ F)))
    (hinvD : Integrable (𝓕⁻ (deriv (inverseGaussian σ F)))) :
    Integrable (fun v => |v| ^ κ * ‖𝓕⁻ (inverseGaussian σ F) v‖ ^ 2) ∧
    weightedEnergy κ (𝓕⁻ (inverseGaussian σ F)) ≤
      ((6 / Real.pi) * (a ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        (b + 12 * Real.pi * a) ^ 2)) *
      h ^ (κ + 1) * (1 + σ / h) ^ 4 * Real.exp (36 * (σ / h) ^ 2)

    originalObjective X Y β h =

name: Causalean.Mathlib.FWL.residualizedObjective_eq_fwlCoef_add_error
statement:
theorem residualizedObjective_eq_fwlCoef_add_error
    (Y : V) (hQ : IsUnit (gramResid H X).det) (β : Fin K → ℝ) :
    residualizedObjective H X Y β =
      residualizedObjective H X Y (fwlCoef H X Y) +
        inner ℝ

statement:
theorem certified_contour_evaluation (program : ContourProgram)
    (bounds : ContourValueBounds program) (separation : PosRat)
    (scheduled : CertifiedProgramSchedule program bounds separation)
    (certificate : DenominatorCertificate program scheduled.schedule)
    (hseparation : separation.1 ≤ certificate.separation)
    (hden : ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      program.denominator.value
        ((program.radius : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2 : ℝ) * Real.pi * u) * Complex.I)) ≠ 0)
    (hLip : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖program.normalizedIntegrand scheduled.schedule s -
        program.normalizedIntegrand scheduled.schedule t‖ ≤
        (scheduled.schedule.lipschitzConstant : ℝ) * |s - t|) :
    (program.evaluate scheduled.schedule certificate).Contains
        program.normalizedContourIntegral ∧
      (program.evaluate scheduled.schedule certificate).re.width ≤
        scheduled.schedule.tolerance.1

    (hschedule : scheduled.schedule.tolerance = inverseMaxTolerance n)
    (certificate : DenominatorCertificate program scheduled.schedule)
    (hseparation : separation.1 ≤ certificate.separation)
    (hden : ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      program.denominator.value
        ((program.radius : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2 : ℝ) * Real.pi * u) * Complex.I)) ≠ 0)
    (hLip : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖program.normalizedIntegrand scheduled.schedule s -
        program.normalizedIntegrand scheduled.schedule t‖ ≤
        (scheduled.schedule.lipschitzConstant : ℝ) * |s - t|) :
    (program.evaluate scheduled.schedule certificate).re.width ≤
      1 / (max n 1 : ℚ)

    {q p : ℝ → ℝ} (hq : DifferentiableOn ℝ q (Icc a b))
    (hp : DifferentiableOn ℝ p (Icc a b))
    (hqpos : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < q x) (hppos : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < p x)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) :

    (hab : a < b) (hm : 0 < m) (hmargin : 0 < margin)
    {q p : ℝ → ℝ} (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 q (Icc a b))
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 p (Icc a b))
    (hqlower : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, m ≤ q x)
    (hplower : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, m ≤ p x)
    (sign : ℝ) (hsign : sign = 1 ∨ sign = -1)
    (hfixed : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      margin ≤ sign * derivWithin (logRatio q p) (Icc a b) x) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ q' p' : ℝ → ℝ,
      DifferentiableOn ℝ q' (Icc a b) →
      DifferentiableOn ℝ p' (Icc a b) →
      C1CloseOn (Icc a b) ε q' q → C1CloseOn (Icc a b) ε p' p →
      (∀ x ∈ Icc a b, 0 < q' x ∧ 0 < p' x ∧
        0 < sign * derivWithin (logRatio q' p') (Icc a b) x)

    (θ a t : ℝ) (hθ_nonneg : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    max 0 (a * t ^ θ - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * t)
      ≤ offsetPeelingConstant θ * a ^ (1 / (1 - θ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.piecewiseLipschitz_chain_bound
statement:
theorem piecewiseLipschitz_chain_bound (k : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ j < k, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      |F j u - F j v| ≤ C * |u - v|)
    (hend : ∀ j, j + 1 < k → F j 1 = F (j + 1) 0)
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j < k)
    (u v : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hv : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (horder : (i : ℝ) + u ≤ (j : ℝ) + v) :
    |F i u - F j v| ≤ C * ((j : ℝ) - (i : ℝ) + v - u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.MeasureTheory.orderedHalfOpenIntervals_cover
statement:
lemma orderedHalfOpenIntervals_cover {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]
    (f : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ) (hf : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → j ≤ n → f i ≤ f j) :
    (⋃ j ∈ Finset.range n, Set.Ico (f j) (f (j + 1))) = Set.Ico (f 0) (f n)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.MeasureTheory.orderedIntervalCells_partition
statement:
lemma orderedIntervalCells_partition {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [MeasurableSpace α]
    [LinearOrder α] [BorelSpace α] [OrderClosedTopology α]
    (f : ℕ → α) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hf : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → j ≤ k → f i ≤ f j) :
    IsIntervalPartition (f 0) (f k) k
      (fun j : Fin k => if j.val + 1 = k then
        Set.Icc (f j.val) (f (j.val + 1))
       else Set.Ico (f j.val) (f (j.val + 1)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.coefficient_bounds
statement:
theorem coefficient_bounds (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ s, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc a b,
      c ≤ β s x z ∧ β s x z ≤ C

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.coefficient_uniform_continuity
statement:
theorem coefficient_uniform_continuity (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (S : ℕ)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      ∀ s (p q : ℝ × ℝ), p ∈ Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b →
        q ∈ Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b →
        dist p q < δ → |β s p.1 p.2 - β s q.1 q.2| < ε

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.diagonal_regular
statement:
theorem diagonal_regular (a b : ℝ) (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    ContinuousOn (diagonalWeight S β) (Set.Icc a b) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 < diagonalWeight S β x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.optimalCost_le_feasible
statement:
theorem optimalCost_le_feasible (a b : ℝ) (S k : ℕ)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (B : Fin k → Set ℝ)
    (z : Fin k → Fin S → ℝ)
    (hB : IsMeasurablePartition a b k B)
    (hz : ∀ j s, z j s ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (hβ : ∀ s x y, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → y ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 ≤ β s x y) :
    optimalCost a b S k β ≤ weightedCost S k β B z

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.sqrt_mass_regular
statement:
theorem sqrt_mass_regular (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) (Set.Icc a b) ∧
      0 < ∫ x in a..b, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.weightedCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem weightedCost_nonneg (a b : ℝ) (S k : ℕ)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (B : Fin k → Set ℝ)
    (z : Fin k → Fin S → ℝ)
    (hB : IsMeasurablePartition a b k B)
    (hz : ∀ j s, z j s ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (hβ : ∀ s x y, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → y ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 ≤ β s x y) :
    0 ≤ weightedCost S k β B z

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.interval_midpoint_moment
statement:
theorem interval_midpoint_moment (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ x in a..b, |x - (a + b) / 2|) = (b - a) ^ 2 / 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.measurable_cell_moment
statement:
theorem measurable_cell_moment (a b z : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hsub : E ⊆ Set.Icc a b) :
    volume.real E ^ 2 / 4 ≤ ∫ x in E, |x - z|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.measurable_cell_tail_lower
statement:
theorem measurable_cell_tail_lower (a b z r : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hsub : E ⊆ Set.Icc a b) :
    volume.real E ≤ 2 * r +
      volume.real (E ∩ {x : ℝ | r ≤ |x - z|})

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.measurable_cell_truncated_layer_cake
statement:
theorem measurable_cell_truncated_layer_cake (a b z : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hsub : E ⊆ Set.Icc a b) :
    (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..volume.real E / 2, (volume.real E - 2 * r)) ≤
      ∫ x in E, |x - z|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.weighted_measurable_cell_moment
statement:
theorem weighted_measurable_cell_moment (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hsub : E ⊆ Set.Icc a b)
    (S : ℕ) (γ : Fin S → ℝ) (hγ : ∀ s, 0 ≤ γ s)
    (z : Fin S → ℝ) :
    ((∑ s : Fin S, γ s) * volume.real E ^ 2 / 4) ≤
      ∑ s : Fin S, γ s * (∫ x in E, |x - z s|)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.boundary_equal_mass
statement:
theorem boundary_equal_mass (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S k j : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (hk : 0 < k) (hj : j ≤ k)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    boundary a b S k j β ∈ Set.Icc a b ∧
      (∫ t in a..boundary a b S k j β,
        Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β t)) =
      (j : ℝ) / k *
        (∫ t in a..b, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β t))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.boundary_order
statement:
theorem boundary_order (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S k : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (hk : 0 < k)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    boundary a b S k 0 β = a ∧ boundary a b S k k β = b ∧
      ∀ i j, i < j → j ≤ k → boundary a b S k i β < boundary a b S k j β

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_cell_midpoint_moment
statement:
theorem companding_cell_midpoint_moment (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S k : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (hk : 0 < k)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z)
    (j : Fin k) (s : Fin S) :
    (∫ x in compandingCell a b S k β j,
      |x - compandingMidpoint a b S k β j s|) =
      (boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β - boundary a b S k j.val β) ^ 2 / 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_coefficient_error_eventually
statement:
theorem companding_coefficient_error_eventually (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → 0 < k →
      ∀ (j : Fin k) (s : Fin S) (x : ℝ),
        x ∈ compandingCell a b S k β j →
        |β s x (compandingMidpoint a b S k β j s) -
          β s (compandingMidpoint a b S k β j s)
            (compandingMidpoint a b S k β j s)| ≤ η

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_feasible
statement:
theorem companding_feasible (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S k : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (hk : 0 < k)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    IsMeasurablePartition a b k (compandingCell a b S k β) ∧
      ∀ j s, compandingMidpoint a b S k β j s ∈ Set.Icc a b

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_interval_mass
statement:
theorem companding_interval_mass (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S k : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (hk : 0 < k)
    (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z)
    (j : Fin k) :
    (∫ x in boundary a b S k j.val β..boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β,
      Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) =
      (∫ x in a..b, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) / k

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_length_bound
statement:
theorem companding_length_bound (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → ∀ j : Fin k,
      c * (boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β - boundary a b S k j.val β) ≤
        (∫ x in a..b, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) / k

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_midpoint_mass_error_eventually
statement:
theorem companding_midpoint_mass_error_eventually (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → 0 < k →
      ∀ j : Fin k,
      |Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β
          ((boundary a b S k j.val β + boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β) / 2)) *
          (boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β - boundary a b S k j.val β) -
        (∫ x in a..b, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) / k| ≤
        η * (boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β - boundary a b S k j.val β)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.far_point_cost_lower
statement:
theorem far_point_cost_lower (S : ℕ) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (z : Fin S → ℝ) (x c δ : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hβ : ∀ s, c ≤ β s x (z s))
    (hfar : ∃ s, δ ≤ |x - z s|) :
    c * δ ≤ ∑ s : Fin S, β s x (z s) * |x - z s|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.good_cell_diameter
statement:
theorem good_cell_diameter (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (z : Fin S → ℝ)
    (x y δ : ℝ) (hx : ∀ s, |x - z s| ≤ δ)
    (hy : ∀ s, |y - z s| ≤ δ) :
    |x - y| ≤ 2 * δ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.far_region_measure_cost
statement:
theorem far_region_measure_cost (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (S : ℕ) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (z : Fin S → ℝ)
    (B G : Set ℝ) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (hsub : B ⊆ Set.Icc a b) (hGB : G ⊆ B)
    (c δ : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hβ : ∀ x ∈ G, ∀ s, c ≤ β s x (z s))
    (hβnonneg : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ s, 0 ≤ β s x (z s))
    (hfar : ∀ x ∈ G, ∃ s, δ ≤ |x - z s|)
    (hInt : ∀ s, IntegrableOn (fun x => β s x (z s) * |x - z s|) B volume) :
    c * δ * volume.real G ≤
      ∑ s : Fin S, ∫ x in B, β s x (z s) * |x - z s|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.near_region_moment_lower
statement:
theorem near_region_moment_lower (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (S : ℕ) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (z : Fin S → ℝ)
    (B G : Set ℝ) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (hsub : B ⊆ Set.Icc a b) (hGB : G ⊆ B)
    (γ : Fin S → ℝ) (hγ : ∀ s, 0 ≤ γ s)
    (hβ : ∀ x ∈ G, ∀ s, γ s ≤ β s x (z s))
    (hβnonneg : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ s, 0 ≤ β s x (z s))
    (hInt : ∀ s, IntegrableOn (fun x => β s x (z s) * |x - z s|) B volume) :
    (∑ s : Fin S, γ s) * volume.real G ^ 2 / 4 ≤
      ∑ s : Fin S, ∫ x in B, β s x (z s) * |x - z s|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.weighted_cell_integrable
statement:
theorem weighted_cell_integrable (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (β : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (B : Set ℝ) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hsub : B ⊆ Set.Icc a b)
    (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => β x z * |x - z|) B volume

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_integrand_cell_error_eventually
statement:
theorem companding_integrand_cell_error_eventually (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → 0 < k →
      ∀ j : Fin k,
        |(∑ s : Fin S, ∫ x in compandingCell a b S k β j,
            β s x (compandingMidpoint a b S k β j s) *
              |x - compandingMidpoint a b S k β j s|) -
          diagonalWeight S β
            ((boundary a b S k j.val β + boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β) / 2) *
            (boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β - boundary a b S k j.val β) ^ 2 / 4| ≤
          η * (boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β -
            boundary a b S k j.val β) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_scaled_cost_tendsto
statement:
theorem companding_scaled_cost_tendsto (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) * weightedCost S k β
      (compandingCell a b S k β) (compandingMidpoint a b S k β))
      atTop (nhds ((1 / 4 : ℝ) *
        (∫ x in a..b, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) ^ 2))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_scaled_length_square_bound
statement:
theorem companding_scaled_length_square_bound (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k →
      (k : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin k,
        (boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β - boundary a b S k j.val β) ^ 2 ≤ C

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_surrogate_cell_error_eventually
statement:
theorem companding_surrogate_cell_error_eventually (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → 0 < k →
      ∀ j : Fin k,
        |diagonalWeight S β
            ((boundary a b S k j.val β + boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β) / 2) *
            (boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β - boundary a b S k j.val β) ^ 2 -
          ((∫ x in a..b, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) / k) ^ 2| ≤
          η * (boundary a b S k (j.val + 1) β -
            boundary a b S k j.val β) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_surrogate_error_tendsto
statement:
theorem companding_surrogate_error_tendsto (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) *
      (weightedCost S k β (compandingCell a b S k β)
        (compandingMidpoint a b S k β) - compandingSurrogateCost a b S k β))
      atTop (nhds 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.companding_surrogate_scaled_tendsto
statement:
theorem companding_surrogate_scaled_tendsto (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) * compandingSurrogateCost a b S k β)
      atTop (nhds ((1 / 4 : ℝ) *
        (∫ x in a..b, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) ^ 2))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.badRegion_measurable
statement:
theorem badRegion_measurable (S k : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (B : Fin k → Set ℝ)

    (δ M ε : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hε : 0 < ε) :

    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z)
    (B : Fin k → Set ℝ) (z : Fin k → Fin S → ℝ)
    (hB : IsMeasurablePartition a b k B)
    (hz : ∀ j s, z j s ∈ Set.Icc a b)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Quantization.partition_good_mass_identity
statement:
theorem partition_good_mass_identity (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (S k : ℕ) (hS : 0 < S) (β : Fin S → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcont : ∀ s, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => β s p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ s x z, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → z ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 < β s x z)
    (B : Fin k → Set ℝ) (z : Fin k → Fin S → ℝ)
    (hB : IsMeasurablePartition a b k B) (δ : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in a..b, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) -
        ∑ j : Fin k, ∫ x in badRegion S k δ B z j,

statement:

    (B G : Set ℝ) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (hsub : B ⊆ Set.Icc a b) (hGB : G ⊆ B)
    (z : Fin S → ℝ) (γ : Fin S → ℝ) (hγ : ∀ s, 0 ≤ γ s)
    (hβ : ∀ x ∈ G, ∀ s, γ s ≤ β s x (z s))
    (hβnonneg : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ s, 0 ≤ β s x (z s))
    (hInt : ∀ s, IntegrableOn (fun x => β s x (z s) * |x - z s|) B volume)
    (Q η : ℝ) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hη : 0 ≤ η ∧ η < 1)
    (hq : ∀ x ∈ G, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x) ≤ Q)
    (hcoeff : (1 - η) * Q ^ 2 ≤ ∑ s : Fin S, γ s) :
    (1 - η) * (∫ x in G, Real.sqrt (diagonalWeight S β x)) ^ 2 / 4 ≤
      ∑ s : Fin S, ∫ x in B, β s x (z s) * |x - z s|

theorem algebraicRankOnePseudoInverse_isMoorePenrose {H : Matrix (Fin 2) E ℝ}
    (hgap : leftGram H ∈ strictGapSet) (hpos : 0 < lambda₁ (leftGram H)) :
    let A := algebraicRankOneTruncation H
    let Aplus := algebraicRankOnePseudoInverse H
    A * Aplus * A = A ∧
      Aplus * A * Aplus = Aplus ∧
      (A * Aplus).IsHermitian ∧
      (Aplus * A).IsHermitian

    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]

    (hi0 : Function.Injective i0) (hi1 : Function.Injective i1)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (v : V) :
    kFunctionalSq (embeddedNorm i0) (embeddedNorm i1) t v =
      ⨅ (e0 : E0) (e1 : E1) (_ : v = i0 e0 + i1 e1),

    (A0 A1 : ℝ≥0∞) (hA0 : 0 < A0 ∧ A0 < ⊤) (hA1 : 0 < A1 ∧ A1 < ⊤)
    (h0 : ∀ v, m0 (D v) ≤ A0 * n0 v) (h1 : ∀ v, m1 (D v) ≤ A1 * n1 v)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (v : V) :
    kFunctionalSq m0 m1 t (D v) ≤
      A0 ^ 2 * kFunctionalSq n0 n1 (t * (A1.toReal / A0.toReal)) v

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.lintegral_weighted_dilation
statement:
theorem lintegral_weighted_dilation (F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hF : Measurable (Set.indicator (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) F))
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-1 - 2 * θ)) * F (t * c)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ (2 * θ)) *
        ∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-1 - 2 * θ)) * F t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.measurable_kFunctionalSq_indicator
statement:
theorem measurable_kFunctionalSq_indicator {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    (n0 n1 : V → ℝ≥0∞) (v : V) :
    Measurable (Set.indicator (Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (fun t => kFunctionalSq n0 n1 t v))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.monotoneOn_kFunctionalSq
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_kFunctionalSq {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    (n0 n1 : V → ℝ≥0∞) (v : V) :
    MonotoneOn (fun t => kFunctionalSq n0 n1 t v) (Ioi (0 : ℝ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.embeddedNorm_endpoint_bound_of_pos
statement:
theorem embeddedNorm_endpoint_bound_of_pos {E V W : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (i : E →L[ℝ] V) (hi : Function.Injective i) (D : V → W) (m : W → ℝ≥0∞)
    (A : ℝ≥0∞) (hA : 0 < A)
    (h : ∀ e, m (D (i e)) ≤ A * ENNReal.ofReal ‖e‖) :
    ∀ v, m (D v) ≤ A * embeddedNorm i v

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.exact_interpolation_operators
statement:
theorem exact_interpolation_operators
    (E0 E1 G0 G1 V W : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup E0] [NormedSpace ℝ E0] [CompleteSpace E0]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E1] [NormedSpace ℝ E1] [CompleteSpace E1]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G0] [NormedSpace ℝ G0] [CompleteSpace G0]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G1] [NormedSpace ℝ G1] [CompleteSpace G1]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W]
    (i0 : E0 →L[ℝ] V) (i1 : E1 →L[ℝ] V)
    (j0 : G0 →L[ℝ] W) (j1 : G1 →L[ℝ] W)
    (hi0 : Function.Injective i0) (hi1 : Function.Injective i1)
    (hj0 : Function.Injective j0) (hj1 : Function.Injective j1)
    (D : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (A0 A1 : ℝ≥0∞) (hA0 : A0 < ⊤) (hA1 : A1 < ⊤)
    (h0 : ∀ e, embeddedNorm j0 (D (i0 e)) ≤ A0 * ENNReal.ofReal ‖e‖)
    (h1 : ∀ e, embeddedNorm j1 (D (i1 e)) ≤ A1 * ENNReal.ofReal ‖e‖)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (v : V)
    (hv : ∃ e0 e1, v = i0 e0 + i1 e1)
    (hvfin : kNormSq (embeddedNorm i0) (embeddedNorm i1) θ v < ⊤) :
    kNormSq (embeddedNorm j0) (embeddedNorm j1) θ (D v) ≤
      (ENNReal.rpow A0 (1 - θ) * ENNReal.rpow A1 θ) ^ 2 *
        kNormSq (embeddedNorm i0) (embeddedNorm i1) θ v

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.kNormSq_map_le_of_pos
statement:
theorem kNormSq_map_le_of_pos {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W]
    (n0 n1 : V → ℝ≥0∞) (m0 m1 : W → ℝ≥0∞) (D : V →+ W)
    (A0 A1 : ℝ≥0∞) (hA0 : 0 < A0 ∧ A0 < ⊤) (hA1 : 0 < A1 ∧ A1 < ⊤)
    (h0 : ∀ v, m0 (D v) ≤ A0 * n0 v) (h1 : ∀ v, m1 (D v) ≤ A1 * n1 v)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (v : V) :
    kNormSq m0 m1 θ (D v) ≤
      (ENNReal.rpow A0 (1 - θ) * ENNReal.rpow A1 θ) ^ 2 * kNormSq n0 n1 θ v

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.le_geometric_of_forall_gt
statement:
theorem le_geometric_of_forall_gt (L K A0 A1 : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hK : K < ⊤) (hA0 : A0 < ⊤) (hA1 : A1 < ⊤)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (h : ∀ B0 B1 : ℝ≥0∞, A0 < B0 → B0 < ⊤ → A1 < B1 → B1 < ⊤ →
      L ≤ (ENNReal.rpow B0 (1 - θ) * ENNReal.rpow B1 θ) ^ 2 * K) :
    L ≤ (ENNReal.rpow A0 (1 - θ) * ENNReal.rpow A1 θ) ^ 2 * K

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.harmonic_quadratic_attained
statement:
theorem harmonic_quadratic_attained (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (z : ℂ) :
    z = (b / (a + b)) • z + (a / (a + b)) • z ∧
    a * ‖(b / (a + b)) • z‖ ^ 2 + b * ‖(a / (a + b)) • z‖ ^ 2 =
      a * b / (a + b) * ‖z‖ ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.harmonic_quadratic_iInf
statement:
theorem harmonic_quadratic_iInf (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (z : ℂ) :
    (⨅ (z0 : ℂ) (z1 : ℂ) (_ : z = z0 + z1),
      ENNReal.ofReal (a * ‖z0‖ ^ 2 + b * ‖z1‖ ^ 2)) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (a * b / (a + b) * ‖z‖ ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.harmonic_quadratic_le
statement:
theorem harmonic_quadratic_le (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (z0 z1 : ℂ) :
    a * b / (a + b) * ‖z0 + z1‖ ^ 2 ≤ a * ‖z0‖ ^ 2 + b * ‖z1‖ ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.lintegral_beta_reflection
statement:
theorem lintegral_beta_reflection (p : ℝ) (hp : p ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫⁻ x in Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ (p - 1) * (1 - x) ^ (-p))) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi / Real.sin (Real.pi * p))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.lintegral_quadratic_kernel
statement:
theorem lintegral_quadratic_kernel (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (1 - 2 * θ) / (1 + t ^ 2))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * θ)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.lintegral_rpow_div_one_add
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_div_one_add (p : ℝ) (hp : p ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫⁻ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ (p - 1) / (1 + x))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi / Real.sin (Real.pi * p))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.lintegral_rpow_div_one_add_eq_beta
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_div_one_add_eq_beta (p : ℝ) (_hp : p ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∫⁻ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ (p - 1) / (1 + x))) =
      ∫⁻ x in Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ (p - 1) * (1 - x) ^ (-p))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.normalized_lintegral_harmonicWeight
statement:
theorem normalized_lintegral_harmonicWeight (a b : ℝ≥0∞)
    (ha : 0 < a ∧ a < ⊤) (hb : 0 < b ∧ b < ⊤)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    normalizationSq θ * (∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-1 - 2 * θ)) * harmonicWeight a b t) =
      ENNReal.rpow a (1 - θ) * ENNReal.rpow b θ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.lintegral_lintegral_swap_of_sigmaFinite_support
statement:
theorem lintegral_lintegral_swap_of_sigmaFinite_support
    {T S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace T] [MeasurableSpace S]
    (ν : Measure T) [SFinite ν] (μ : Measure S) (s : Set S)
    [SigmaFinite (μ.restrict s)] (F : T × S → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hF : Measurable F) (hzero : ∀ t x, x ∉ s → F (t, x) = 0) :
    (∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x, F (t, x) ∂μ ∂ν) = ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ t, F (t, x) ∂ν ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.exists_harmonic_minimizer
statement:
theorem exists_harmonic_minimizer {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    (μ : Measure S) (w0 w1 : S → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw0 : Measurable w0) (hw1 : Measurable w1)
    (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w0 x ∧ w0 x < ⊤ ∧ 0 < w1 x ∧ w1 x < ⊤)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (f : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ) :
    ∃ f0 f1 : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ, f = f0 + f1 ∧
      wNorm w0 μ f0 ^ 2 + ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ 2) * wNorm w1 μ f1 ^ 2 =
        ∫⁻ x, harmonicWeight (w0 x) (w1 x) t * (‖f x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.harmonic_energy_le_cost
statement:
theorem harmonic_energy_le_cost {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    (μ : Measure S) (w0 w1 : S → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw0 : Measurable w0) (hw1 : Measurable w1)
    (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w0 x ∧ w0 x < ⊤ ∧ 0 < w1 x ∧ w1 x < ⊤)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (f f0 f1 : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ) (hf : f = f0 + f1) :
    (∫⁻ x, harmonicWeight (w0 x) (w1 x) t * (‖f x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
      wNorm w0 μ f0 ^ 2 + ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ 2) * wNorm w1 μ f1 ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.kFunctionalSq_wNorm
statement:
theorem kFunctionalSq_wNorm {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    (μ : Measure S) (w0 w1 : S → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw0 : Measurable w0) (hw1 : Measurable w1)
    (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w0 x ∧ w0 x < ⊤ ∧ 0 < w1 x ∧ w1 x < ⊤)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (f : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ) :
    kFunctionalSq (wNorm w0 μ) (wNorm w1 μ) t f =
      ∫⁻ x, harmonicWeight (w0 x) (w1 x) t * (‖f x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.sigmaFinite_restrict_of_ae_pos_of_lintegral_lt_top
statement:
theorem sigmaFinite_restrict_of_ae_pos_of_lintegral_lt_top
    {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S] (μ : Measure S) (s : Set S)
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (g : S → ℝ≥0∞) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → 0 < g x) (hfin : (∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ) < ⊤) :
    SigmaFinite (μ.restrict s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.sigmaFinite_restrict_support_of_endpoint_sum
statement:
theorem sigmaFinite_restrict_support_of_endpoint_sum {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    (μ : Measure S) (w0 w1 : S → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw0 : Measurable w0) (hw1 : Measurable w1)
    (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w0 x ∧ w0 x < ⊤ ∧ 0 < w1 x ∧ w1 x < ⊤)
    (f : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ)
    (hf : ∃ f0 f1 : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ, f = f0 + f1 ∧
      wNorm w0 μ f0 < ⊤ ∧ wNorm w1 μ f1 < ⊤) :
    SigmaFinite (μ.restrict {x | f x ≠ 0})

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.lintegral_harmonic_energy_comm
statement:
theorem lintegral_harmonic_energy_comm {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    (μ : Measure S) (w0 w1 : S → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw0 : Measurable w0) (hw1 : Measurable w1)
    (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w0 x ∧ w0 x < ⊤ ∧ 0 < w1 x ∧ w1 x < ⊤)
    (θ : ℝ) (f : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ)
    (hf : ∃ f0 f1 : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ, f = f0 + f1 ∧
      wNorm w0 μ f0 < ⊤ ∧ wNorm w1 μ f1 < ⊤) :
    (∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-1 - 2 * θ)) *
      ∫⁻ x, harmonicWeight (w0 x) (w1 x) t * (‖f x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 ∂μ) =
    ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-1 - 2 * θ)) * harmonicWeight (w0 x) (w1 x) t) *
        (‖f x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RealInterpolation.weighted_l2_interpolation
statement:
theorem weighted_l2_interpolation {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    (μ : Measure S) (w0 w1 : S → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw0 : Measurable w0) (hw1 : Measurable w1)
    (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w0 x ∧ w0 x < ⊤ ∧ 0 < w1 x ∧ w1 x < ⊤)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (f : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ)
    (hf : ∃ f0 f1 : S →ₘ[μ] ℂ, f = f0 + f1 ∧
      wNorm w0 μ f0 < ⊤ ∧ wNorm w1 μ f1 < ⊤) :
    kNormSq (wNorm w0 μ) (wNorm w1 μ) θ f =
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.rpow (w0 x) (1 - θ) * ENNReal.rpow (w1 x) θ *
        (‖f x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.ContinuousLinearMap.abs_singularValues_add_sub_singularValues_le
statement:
theorem ContinuousLinearMap.abs_singularValues_add_sub_singularValues_le
    (A D : V →L[ℝ] W) (j : ℕ) :
    |(A + D).toLinearMap.singularValues j - A.toLinearMap.singularValues j| ≤ ‖D‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.abs_singularValues_add_sub_singularValues_le_opNorm
statement:
theorem abs_singularValues_add_sub_singularValues_le_opNorm
    (A D : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (j : ℕ) :
    |(A + D).singularValues j - A.singularValues j| ≤ ‖D.toContinuousLinearMap‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.exists_large_subspace_norm_le_singularValues
statement:
theorem exists_large_subspace_norm_le_singularValues
    (A : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < finrank ℝ V) :
    ∃ S : Submodule ℝ V,
      finrank ℝ V ≤ finrank ℝ S + j ∧
      ∀ x : V, x ∈ S → ‖A x‖ ≤ A.singularValues j * ‖x‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.singularValues_add_le_add_opNorm
statement:
theorem singularValues_add_le_add_opNorm
    (A D : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (j : ℕ) :
    (A + D).singularValues j ≤ A.singularValues j + ‖D.toContinuousLinearMap‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.singularValues_le_of_large_subspace
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_of_large_subspace
    (A : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < finrank ℝ V)
    (S : Submodule ℝ V) (hdim : finrank ℝ V ≤ finrank ℝ S + j)
    {c : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ x : V, x ∈ S → ‖A x‖ ≤ c * ‖x‖) :
    A.singularValues j ≤ c

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.le_singularValues_of_subspace
statement:
theorem le_singularValues_of_subspace
    (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (S : Submodule ℝ E) {j : ℕ} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hdim : j < finrank ℝ S)
    (hbound : ∀ x : E, x ∈ S → c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x‖) :
    c ≤ T.singularValues j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.least_singularValue_mul_norm_le
statement:
theorem least_singularValue_mul_norm_le
    [Nontrivial E] (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hT : Function.Injective T) (x : E) :
    T.singularValues (finrank ℝ E - 1) * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.least_singularValue_mul_norm_le_adjoint_on_range
statement:
theorem least_singularValue_mul_norm_le_adjoint_on_range
    [Nontrivial K] (B : K →ₗ[ℝ] E) (hB : Function.Injective B)
    (y : E) (hy : y ∈ B.range) :
    B.singularValues (finrank ℝ K - 1) * ‖y‖ ≤ ‖B.adjoint y‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.singularValues_comp_linearIsometry_last
statement:
theorem singularValues_comp_linearIsometry_last
    (M : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (V : K →ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (hrange : V.toLinearMap.range = M.adjoint.range) :
    (M ∘ₗ V.toLinearMap).singularValues (finrank ℝ K - 1) =
      M.singularValues (finrank ℝ K - 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.singularValues_comp_linearIsometry_of_range_eq_adjoint_range
statement:
theorem singularValues_comp_linearIsometry_of_range_eq_adjoint_range
    (M : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (V : K →ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (hrange : V.toLinearMap.range = M.adjoint.range) (j : ℕ) :
    (M ∘ₗ V.toLinearMap).singularValues j = M.singularValues j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.singularValues_le_verticalStack_left
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_verticalStack_left
    (M₀ : E →ₗ[ℝ] F₀) (M₁ : E →ₗ[ℝ] F₁) (j : ℕ) :
    M₀.singularValues j ≤ (verticalStack M₀ M₁).singularValues j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.singularValues_le_verticalStack_right
statement:
theorem singularValues_le_verticalStack_right
    (M₀ : E →ₗ[ℝ] F₀) (M₁ : E →ₗ[ℝ] F₁) (j : ℕ) :
    M₁.singularValues j ≤ (verticalStack M₀ M₁).singularValues j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.singularValues_product_adjoint_lower_bound
statement:
theorem singularValues_product_adjoint_lower_bound
    [Nontrivial K]
    (A : K →ₗ[ℝ] F) (D : K →ₗ[ℝ] K) (B : K →ₗ[ℝ] E)
    (hA : Function.Injective A) (hD : Function.Injective D)
    (hB : Function.Injective B) :
    A.singularValues (finrank ℝ K - 1) *
          D.singularValues (finrank ℝ K - 1) *
          B.singularValues (finrank ℝ K - 1) ≤
      (A ∘ₗ D ∘ₗ B.adjoint).singularValues (finrank ℝ K - 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.verticalStack_adjoint_comp_self
statement:
theorem verticalStack_adjoint_comp_self
    (M₀ : E →ₗ[ℝ] F₀) (M₁ : E →ₗ[ℝ] F₁) :
    (verticalStack M₀ M₁).adjoint ∘ₗ verticalStack M₀ M₁ =
      (M₀.adjoint ∘ₗ M₀) + (M₁.adjoint ∘ₗ M₁)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.RpowArith.div_rpow_of_nonneg_of_pos
statement:
lemma div_rpow_of_nonneg_of_pos
    (A p n : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (A / n) ^ p = A ^ p * n ^ (-p)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.RpowArith.inv_eq_rpow_neg_one
statement: lemma inv_eq_rpow_neg_one (x : ℝ) : x⁻¹ = x ^ (-1 : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.RpowArith.inv_mul_sqrt_eq_rpow_neg_half
statement:
lemma inv_mul_sqrt_eq_rpow_neg_half (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    q⁻¹ * Real.sqrt q = q ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.RpowArith.rpow_natCast_nonpos_le_one
statement:
lemma rpow_natCast_nonpos_le_one
    (n : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (he : e ≤ 0) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ e ≤ 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.RpowArith.window_log_power_comparison
statement:
lemma window_log_power_comparison (K d w a b : ℝ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≤ K * b) :
    Real.log (Real.exp 1 + w * a ^ d) ≤
      (1 + d * Real.log K) * Real.log (Real.exp 1 + w * b ^ d)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.RpowArith.window_log_power_le
statement:
lemma window_log_power_le (K d w a b : ℝ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≤ K * b) :
    Real.log (Real.exp 1 + w * a ^ d) ≤
      d * Real.log K + Real.log (Real.exp 1 + w * b ^ d)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.RpowArith.window_sqrt_log_comparison
statement:
lemma window_sqrt_log_comparison (K d w a b : ℝ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≤ K * b) :
    Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.exp 1 + w * a ^ d)) ≤
      (1 + d * Real.log K) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.exp 1 + w * b ^ d))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.descentStep_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem descentStep_mem_Icc {M c T : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    descentStep M c T ∈ Icc 0 T

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.descentStep_of_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descentStep_of_eq_zero (c T : ℝ) : descentStep 0 c T = T

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.descentStep_of_pos
statement:
theorem descentStep_of_pos {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (c T : ℝ) :
    descentStep M c T = min T (c / M)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.first_order_descent_gap
statement:
theorem first_order_descent_gap {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Icc 0 T)) (hf0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f 0)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, deriv (deriv f) t ≤ 0) (hslope : deriv f 0 ≤ -c) :
    f 0 - f T ≥ c * T

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.first_order_upper_bound
statement:
theorem first_order_upper_bound {f : ℝ → ℝ} {T : ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Icc 0 T)) (hf0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f 0)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, deriv (deriv f) t ≤ 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    f t ≤ f 0 + deriv f 0 * t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.second_order_descent_gap
statement:
theorem second_order_descent_gap {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M c T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hMnn : 0 ≤ M) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Icc 0 T)) (hf0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f 0)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, deriv (deriv f) t ≤ M) (hslope : deriv f 0 ≤ -c) :
    descentStep M c T ∈ Icc 0 T ∧
      f 0 - f (descentStep M c T) ≥
        c * descentStep M c T - (M / 2) * descentStep M c T ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.second_order_descent_gap_half
statement:
theorem second_order_descent_gap_half {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M c T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hMnn : 0 ≤ M) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Icc 0 T)) (hf0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f 0)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, deriv (deriv f) t ≤ M) (hslope : deriv f 0 ≤ -c) :
    descentStep M c T ∈ Icc 0 T ∧
      f 0 - f (descentStep M c T) ≥ (c / 2) * descentStep M c T

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.second_order_descent_gap_min
statement:
theorem second_order_descent_gap_min {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M c T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hMpos : 0 < M) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Icc 0 T)) (hf0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f 0)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, deriv (deriv f) t ≤ M) (hslope : deriv f 0 ≤ -c) :
    f 0 - f (min T (c / M)) ≥ (c / 2) * min T (c / M)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.second_order_upper_bound
statement:
theorem second_order_upper_bound {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M T : ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Icc 0 T)) (hf0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f 0)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, deriv (deriv f) t ≤ M) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    f t ≤ f 0 + deriv f 0 * t + (M / 2) * t ^ 2

statement:
theorem affine_deriv_energy_le_max (E : ℝ → ℝ) (A B x : ℝ)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hE : ContinuousOn E (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hd : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ E y)
    (hder : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∃ q : ℝ, 0 ≤ q ∧ deriv E y = (-A + B * y) * q)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    E x ≤ max (E 0) (E 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.abs_h_le_one
statement:

    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : |h k α x| ≤ 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.jacobiShifted_abs_le_one
statement:
theorem jacobiShifted_abs_le_one (k : ℕ) (α β x : ℝ)
    (hβα : β ≤ α) (hβ : -1 < β) (hα : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ α)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : |jacobiShifted k α β x| ≤ 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.jacobiShifted_coefficient_recurrence
statement:
theorem jacobiShifted_coefficient_recurrence (k m : ℕ) (α β : ℝ)
    (hα : -1 < α) (hm : m < k) :
    ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (α + (m : ℝ) + 1) *
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) * (k.choose (m + 1) : ℝ) *
          (rising ((k : ℝ) + α + β + 1) (m + 1) /
            rising (α + 1) (m + 1))) =
      -((k : ℝ) - (m : ℝ)) * ((k : ℝ) + α + β + (m : ℝ) + 1) *
        ((-1 : ℝ) ^ m * (k.choose m : ℝ) *
          (rising ((k : ℝ) + α + β + 1) m /
            rising (α + 1) m))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.jacobiShifted_ode
statement:
theorem jacobiShifted_ode (k : ℕ) (α β x : ℝ) (hα : -1 < α) :
    x * (1 - x) * deriv (deriv (jacobiShifted k α β)) x +
      (α + 1 - (α + β + 2) * x) * deriv (jacobiShifted k α β) x +
      (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) + α + β + 1) * jacobiShifted k α β x = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.jacobiShifted_one
statement:
theorem jacobiShifted_one (k : ℕ) (α β : ℝ) (hα : -1 < α) :
    jacobiShifted k α β 1 =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * rising (β + 1) k / rising (α + 1) k

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.jacobiShifted_zero
statement: theorem jacobiShifted_zero (k : ℕ) (α β : ℝ) : jacobiShifted k α β 0 = 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.rising_pos
statement: theorem rising_pos (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) : 0 < rising a n

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.integral_rpow_mul_one_sub_pow
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_mul_one_sub_pow (k : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ (α - 1) * (1 - x) ^ k) =
      (Nat.factorial k : ℝ) / (α * rising (α + 1) k)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.integral_mul_iterated_deriv_eq
statement:
theorem integral_mul_iterated_deriv_eq (k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (p f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ p x)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ f x)
    (hbd : ∀ i < k, (deriv^[i] f) a = 0 ∧ (deriv^[i] f) b = 0)
    (hab : a < b) :
    (∫ x in a..b, p x * (deriv^[k] f) x) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * (∫ x in a..b, (deriv^[k] p) x * f x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.integral_mul_iterated_deriv_with_boundary
statement:
theorem integral_mul_iterated_deriv_with_boundary (k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
    (p f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ p x)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ f x)
    (hab : a < b) :
    (∫ x in a..b, p x * (deriv^[k] f) x) =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k,
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ i *
          ((deriv^[i] p) b * (deriv^[k - 1 - i] f) b -
           (deriv^[i] p) a * (deriv^[k - 1 - i] f) a)) +
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ k *
          (∫ x in a..b, (deriv^[k] p) x * f x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.iter_deriv_mul_one_sub_pow_at_one
statement:
theorem iter_deriv_mul_one_sub_pow_at_one (g : ℝ → ℝ) (k i : ℕ)
    (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ g 1) (hi : i < k) :
    (deriv^[i] (fun x : ℝ => g x * (1 - x) ^ k)) 1 = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.tendsto_integral_one_div_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_one_div_nat (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 1) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in (1 / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))..1, f x)
      atTop (nhds (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.iter_deriv_aeval_int
statement:
lemma iter_deriv_aeval_int (p : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    deriv^[n] (fun x : ℝ => Polynomial.aeval x p) =
      fun x : ℝ => Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.derivative^[n] p)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.iterate_derivative_shiftedLegendre
statement:
lemma iterate_derivative_shiftedLegendre (k : ℕ) :
    Polynomial.derivative^[k] (Polynomial.shiftedLegendre k) =
      Polynomial.C ((k.factorial : ℤ) * ((-1 : ℤ)^k * ((2*k).choose k : ℤ)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.jacobiShifted_zero_zero_eq_shiftedLegendre
statement:
lemma jacobiShifted_zero_zero_eq_shiftedLegendre (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    jacobiShifted n 0 0 x =
      Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.shiftedLegendre n)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.rod_boundary_zero
statement:
lemma rod_boundary_zero (k i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) :
    (deriv^[i] (fun x : ℝ => x^k * (1-x)^k)) 0 = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.shiftedLegendre_orthogonal_unit
statement:
lemma shiftedLegendre_orthogonal_unit (j k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.shiftedLegendre j) *
      Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.shiftedLegendre k)) =
      if j = k then 1 / (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.shiftedLegendre_orthogonal_unit_of_lt
statement:
lemma shiftedLegendre_orthogonal_unit_of_lt {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j < k) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.shiftedLegendre j) *
      Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.shiftedLegendre k)) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.shiftedLegendre_rodrigues_eval
statement:
lemma shiftedLegendre_rodrigues_eval (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (n.factorial : ℝ) * Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.shiftedLegendre n) =
      (deriv^[n] (fun y : ℝ => y^n * (1-y)^n)) x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.shiftedLegendre_sq_integral_unit
statement:
lemma shiftedLegendre_sq_integral_unit (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.shiftedLegendre k) : ℝ) ^ 2) =
      1 / (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.h_rodrigues
statement:
theorem h_rodrigues (k : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hx : 0 < x) :
    x ^ α * h k α x =
      (deriv^[k] (rodKernel k α)) x / rising (α + 1) k

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.rodKernel_deriv_expansion
statement:
theorem rodKernel_deriv_expansion (k i : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    (deriv^[i] (rodKernel k α)) x =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ m * (k.choose m : ℝ) *
          (descPochhammer ℝ i).eval (α + (k : ℝ) + (m : ℝ)) *
            x ^ (α + (k : ℝ) + (m : ℝ) - (i : ℝ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.rodKernel_deriv_one
statement:
theorem rodKernel_deriv_one (k i : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hik : i < k)
    (hα : 0 < α) : (deriv^[i] (rodKernel k α)) 1 = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.rodKernel_deriv_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem rodKernel_deriv_tendsto_zero (k i : ℕ) (α : ℝ)
    (hik : i < k) (hα : 0 < α) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (deriv^[i] (rodKernel k α)) x)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.rodKernel_expansion_eq_h
statement:
theorem rodKernel_expansion_eq_h (k : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hx : 0 < x) :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ m * (k.choose m : ℝ) *
          (descPochhammer ℝ k).eval (α + (k : ℝ) + (m : ℝ)) *
            x ^ (α + (k : ℝ) + (m : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))) =
      rising (α + 1) k * (x ^ α * h k α x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.inv_mul_rodKernel_deriv_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem inv_mul_rodKernel_deriv_tendsto_zero (k i : ℕ) (α : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hik : i < k) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x : ℝ => (deriv^[i] (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹)) x *
        (deriv^[k - 1 - i] (rodKernel k α)) x)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.h_weight_intervalIntegrable
statement:
theorem h_weight_intervalIntegrable (k j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (α - 1 + (j : ℝ)) * h k α x)
      volume 0 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.h_weighted_moment_zero
statement:
theorem h_weighted_moment_zero (k j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ (α - 1 + (j : ℝ)) * h k α x) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.h_zeroth_moment_gamma
statement:
theorem h_zeroth_moment_gamma (k : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    α * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ (α - 1) * h k α x) =
      (Real.Gamma (α + 1) * Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) + 1) /
        Real.Gamma ((k : ℝ) + α + 1)) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.h_zeroth_moment_rising
statement:
theorem h_zeroth_moment_rising (k : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    α * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ (α - 1) * h k α x) =
      ((Nat.factorial k : ℝ) / rising (α + 1) k) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.rising_eq_gamma_ratio
statement:
theorem rising_eq_gamma_ratio (k : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    rising (α + 1) k =
      Real.Gamma (α + (k : ℝ) + 1) / Real.Gamma (α + 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.factorial_div_rising_power_bounds
statement:
theorem factorial_div_rising_power_bounds (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ,
        c * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-α) ≤
          ((Nat.factorial k : ℝ) / rising (α + 1) k) ∧
        ((Nat.factorial k : ℝ) / rising (α + 1) k) ≤
          C * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-α)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Jacobi.h_zeroth_moment_power_bounds
statement:
theorem h_zeroth_moment_power_bounds (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
        c * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-(2 * α)) ≤
          α * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ (α - 1) * h k α x) ∧
        α * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, x ^ (α - 1) * h k α x) ≤
          C * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-(2 * α))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.tendsto_min_one_rpow_zero_iff
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.PowerIntegral.integral_inv_neg_Ioc

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.PowerIntegral.integral_rpow_neg_Ioc
