name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.anchor_projector_eq_clusterMass
statement:
theorem anchor_projector_eq_clusterMass
    {n : ℕ} {A : RectMatrix n n} (D : RealDiagonalization A)
    (mass left right : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hleft : left = Matrix.mulVec D.basisInv.transpose mass)
    (hright : Matrix.mulVec D.basisInv right = fun _ => 1) (x : ℝ) :
    ∑ a, left a * (∑ b, D.projector x a b * right b) =
      ∑ u, if D.eigenvalue u = x then mass u else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.complete_clusterMass_integral_eq
statement:
theorem complete_clusterMass_integral_eq
    {n : ℕ} (mass eig value : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hmasspos : ∀ u, 0 < mass u) (hmasssum : ∑ u, mass u = 1)
    (hcomplete : ∀ u, ∃ i, eig u = value i)
    (houtsum : ∑ i, (∑ u, if eig u = value i then mass u else 0) = 1) :
    ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ,
      ∑ i, (∑ u, if eig u = value i then mass u else 0) * f (value i) =
        ∑ u, mass u * f (eig u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.complexEigenvalue_mem_diagonal
statement:
theorem complexEigenvalue_mem_diagonal
    {n : ℕ} {A : RectMatrix n n} (D : RealDiagonalization A)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ComplexMatrixEigenvalue A z) :
    ∃ u, z = D.eigenvalue u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.exists_injective_spectralEnumeration
statement:
theorem exists_injective_spectralEnumeration
    {n : ℕ} {A : RectMatrix n n} (D : RealDiagonalization A)
    {radius : ℝ} (hradius : 0 < radius)
    (hbound : ∀ u, D.eigenvalue u ∈ Set.Icc (-radius) radius) :
    ∃ value : Fin n → ℝ,
      Function.Injective value ∧
      (∀ u, ∃ i, value i = D.eigenvalue u) ∧
      ∀ i, value i ∈ Set.Icc (-radius) radius

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.exists_polynomialSpectralLaw
statement:
theorem exists_polynomialSpectralLaw
    {n : ℕ} {A : RectMatrix n n} (D : RealDiagonalization A)
    {radius : ℝ} (hradius : 0 < radius)
    (mass left right : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hmass : (∀ u, 0 ≤ mass u) ∧ ∑ u, mass u = 1)
    (hbound : ∀ u, D.eigenvalue u ∈ Set.Icc (-radius) radius)
    (hleft : left = Matrix.mulVec D.basisInv.transpose mass)
    (hright : Matrix.mulVec D.basisInv right = fun _ => 1) :
    ∃ value : Fin n → ℝ,
      Function.Injective value ∧
      (∀ u, ∃ i, value i = D.eigenvalue u) ∧
      (∀ i, value i ∈ Set.Icc (-radius) radius) ∧
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ ∑ a, left a *
        (∑ b, polynomialSpectralProjector A value i a b * right b)) ∧
      ∑ i, (∑ a, left a *
        (∑ b, polynomialSpectralProjector A value i a b * right b)) = 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.polynomialSpectralProjector_eq_projector_or_zero
statement:
theorem polynomialSpectralProjector_eq_projector_or_zero
    {n : ℕ} {A : RectMatrix n n} (D : RealDiagonalization A)
    (value : Fin n → ℝ) (hinj : Function.Injective value)
    (hcomplete : ∀ u, ∃ i, value i = D.eigenvalue u) (i : Fin n) :
    polynomialSpectralProjector A value i =
      if value i ∈ D.spectralValues then D.projector (value i) else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.polynomialSpectralProjector_eq_projector_or_zero_of_complete
statement:
theorem polynomialSpectralProjector_eq_projector_or_zero_of_complete
    {n : ℕ} {A : RectMatrix n n} (D : RealDiagonalization A)
    (value : Fin n → ℝ) (hcomplete : ∀ u, ∃ i, value i = D.eigenvalue u)
    (i : Fin n) :
    polynomialSpectralProjector A value i =
      if value i ∈ D.spectralValues then D.projector (value i) else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.abs_weighted_inner_le
statement:
lemma abs_weighted_inner_le (s : Finset ι) (w f g : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    |∑ i ∈ s, w i * (f i * g i)| ≤
      Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, w i * g i ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.abs_weighted_mean_le_sqrt_weighted_sq
statement:
lemma abs_weighted_mean_le_sqrt_weighted_sq (s : Finset ι) (w f : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (c : ℝ) (hmass : ∑ i ∈ s, w i ≤ c) :
    |∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i| ≤
      Real.sqrt c * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.weighted_inner_sq_le
statement:
lemma weighted_inner_sq_le (s : Finset ι) (w f g : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i * (f i * g i)) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, w i * f i ^ 2) * (∑ i ∈ s, w i * g i ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.weighted_sqrt_le_sqrt_weighted
statement:
lemma weighted_sqrt_le_sqrt_weighted (s : Finset ι) (w q : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (c : ℝ) (hmass : ∑ i ∈ s, w i ≤ c)
    (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i * Real.sqrt (q i) ≤
      Real.sqrt c * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, w i * q i)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.BooleanCubeMobius.coeff_sum
statement:
lemma coeff_sum (A B : Finset ι) (hAB : A ⊆ B) :
    (∑ S ∈ B.powerset.filter (A ⊆ ·), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (S.card - A.card))
      = if A = B then 1 else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.BooleanCubeMobius.indicator_empty
statement:
@[simp] lemma indicator_empty :
    indicator (∅ : Finset ι) = fun _ => 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.BooleanCubeMobius.mobius_expansion
statement:
theorem mobius_expansion
    [Fintype ι]
    (τ : (ι → Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (hτ0 : τ (fun _ => 0) = 0)
    (h : ι → Fin 2) :
    τ h =
      ∑ S ∈ (((Finset.univ : Finset ι).powerset.filter (·.Nonempty)) :
        Finset (Finset ι)),
        delta τ S * Finset.prod S (fun k => ((h k).val : ℝ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.BooleanCubeMobius.prod_indicator_eq
statement:
lemma prod_indicator_eq (h : ι → Fin 2)
    (B : Finset ι) (hB : ∀ k, k ∈ B ↔ h k = 1)
    (S : Finset ι) :
    Finset.prod S (fun k => ((h k).val : ℝ)) = if S ⊆ B then 1 else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.card_omega
statement: theorem card_omega (hMn : M ≤ n) : Fintype.card (Omega n M) = n.choose M

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.degreeAtMost_eq_top
statement:
theorem degreeAtMost_eq_top (hMn : M ≤ n) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.degreeAtMost_mono
statement:
theorem degreeAtMost_mono {d e : ℕ} (hde : d ≤ e) :
    degreeAtMost n M d ≤ degreeAtMost n M e

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.mean_constFn
statement:
theorem mean_constFn (hMn : M ≤ n) (c : ℝ) :
    mean (constFn (n := n) (M := M) c) = c

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.mem_degreeAtMost_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degreeAtMost_zero_iff (hMn : M ≤ n) (f : SliceFn n M) :
    f ∈ degreeAtMost n M 0 ↔ ∃ c : ℝ, f = constFn c

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.sliceInner_eq
statement:
theorem sliceInner_eq (hMn : M ≤ n) (f g : SliceFn n M) :
    sliceInner f g = (n.choose M : ℝ)⁻¹ * inner ℝ f g

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.degreeAtMost_eq_iSup_harmonic
statement:
theorem degreeAtMost_eq_iSup_harmonic :
    degreeAtMost n M M = ⨆ k : Fin (M + 1), johnsonHarmonic n M k.1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.degreeAtMost_succ_eq_sup_harmonic
statement:
theorem degreeAtMost_succ_eq_sup_harmonic (d : ℕ) :
    degreeAtMost n M (d + 1) =
      degreeAtMost n M d ⊔ johnsonHarmonic n M (d + 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.harmonicProjection_add
statement:
theorem harmonicProjection_add (k : Fin (M + 1)) (f g : SliceFn n M) :
    harmonicProjection n M k (f + g) =
      harmonicProjection n M k f + harmonicProjection n M k g

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.harmonicProjection_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem harmonicProjection_eq_self_iff (k : Fin (M + 1)) (f : SliceFn n M) :
    harmonicProjection n M k f = f ↔ f ∈ johnsonHarmonic n M k.1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.harmonicProjection_idem
statement:
theorem harmonicProjection_idem (k : Fin (M + 1)) (f : SliceFn n M) :
    harmonicProjection n M k (harmonicProjection n M k f) = harmonicProjection n M k f

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.harmonicProjection_mem
statement:
theorem harmonicProjection_mem (k : Fin (M + 1)) (f : SliceFn n M) :
    harmonicProjection n M k f ∈ johnsonHarmonic n M k.1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.harmonicProjection_pairwise_orthogonal
statement:
theorem harmonicProjection_pairwise_orthogonal (hMn : M ≤ n)
    (f : SliceFn n M) {j k : Fin (M + 1)} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    sliceInner (harmonicProjection n M j f) (harmonicProjection n M k f) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.harmonicProjection_smul
statement:
theorem harmonicProjection_smul (k : Fin (M + 1)) (c : ℝ) (f : SliceFn n M) :
    harmonicProjection n M k (c • f) = c • harmonicProjection n M k f

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.harmonicProjection_zero_eq_mean
statement:
theorem harmonicProjection_zero_eq_mean (hMn : M ≤ n) (f : SliceFn n M) :
    harmonicProjection n M (⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ M⟩ : Fin (M + 1)) f =
      constFn (mean f)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.johnsonHarmonic_pairwise_orthogonal
statement:
theorem johnsonHarmonic_pairwise_orthogonal (hMn : M ≤ n)
    {j k : Fin (M + 1)} (hjk : j ≠ k)
    {f g : SliceFn n M} (hf : f ∈ johnsonHarmonic n M j.1)
    (hg : g ∈ johnsonHarmonic n M k.1) :
    sliceInner f g = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.sliceInner_residual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sliceInner_residual_eq_zero (hMn : M ≤ n) (k : Fin (M + 1))
    (f g : SliceFn n M) (hg : g ∈ johnsonHarmonic n M k.1) :
    sliceInner (f - harmonicProjection n M k f) g = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.sum_harmonicProjection_eq
statement:
theorem sum_harmonicProjection_eq (hMn : M ≤ n) (f : SliceFn n M) :
    (∑ k : Fin (M + 1), harmonicProjection n M k f) = f

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.sum_positive_harmonicProjection_eq_center
statement:
theorem sum_positive_harmonicProjection_eq_center (hMn : M ≤ n)
    (f : SliceFn n M) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin (M + 1) => 0 < k.1),
      harmonicProjection n M k f) = center f

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.disjointIndicator_eq_sum_powerset
statement:
theorem disjointIndicator_eq_sum_powerset (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    disjointIndicator (M := M) S =
      ∑ T ∈ S.powerset, ((-1 : ℝ) ^ T.card) • inclusionMonomial (M := M) T

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.kneserAdjacency_eigen
statement:
theorem kneserAdjacency_eigen (h2 : 2 * M ≤ n) (k : Fin (M + 1))
    (f : SliceFn n M) (hf : f ∈ johnsonHarmonic n M k.1) :
    kneserAdjacency n M f =
      (((-1 : ℝ) ^ k.1) * ((n - M - k.1).choose (M - k.1) : ℝ)) • f

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.kneserAdjacency_harmonicProjection
statement:
theorem kneserAdjacency_harmonicProjection (h2 : 2 * M ≤ n)
    (k : Fin (M + 1)) (f : SliceFn n M) :
    kneserAdjacency n M (harmonicProjection n M k f) =
      (((-1 : ℝ) ^ k.1) * ((n - M - k.1).choose (M - k.1) : ℝ)) •
        harmonicProjection n M k f

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.kneserAdjacency_inclusionMonomial_eq
statement:
theorem kneserAdjacency_inclusionMonomial_eq (h2 : 2 * M ≤ n)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (hSM : S.card ≤ M) :
    kneserAdjacency n M (inclusionMonomial (M := M) S) =
      ((n - M - S.card).choose (M - S.card) : ℝ) •
        disjointIndicator (M := M) S

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.kneserAdjacency_inclusionMonomial_mod_lower
statement:
theorem kneserAdjacency_inclusionMonomial_mod_lower (h2 : 2 * M ≤ n)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (hSd : S.card = d) (hdM : d ≤ M) :
    kneserAdjacency n M (inclusionMonomial (M := M) S) -
        (((-1 : ℝ) ^ d) * ((n - M - d).choose (M - d) : ℝ)) •
          inclusionMonomial (M := M) S ∈
      degreeAtMost n M (d - 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.kneserAdjacency_mem_degreeAtMost
statement:
theorem kneserAdjacency_mem_degreeAtMost (h2 : 2 * M ≤ n)
    {d : ℕ} (hdM : d ≤ M) (f : SliceFn n M)
    (hf : f ∈ degreeAtMost n M d) :
    kneserAdjacency n M f ∈ degreeAtMost n M d

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.kneserAdjacency_sub_eigen_mem_lower
statement:
theorem kneserAdjacency_sub_eigen_mem_lower (h2 : 2 * M ≤ n)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hdM : d ≤ M) (f : SliceFn n M)
    (hf : f ∈ degreeAtMost n M d) :
    kneserAdjacency n M f -
        (((-1 : ℝ) ^ d) * ((n - M - d).choose (M - d) : ℝ)) • f ∈
      degreeAtMost n M (d - 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.normalizedKneserAdjacency_eigen
statement:
theorem normalizedKneserAdjacency_eigen (h2 : 2 * M ≤ n)
    (k : Fin (M + 1)) (f : SliceFn n M)
    (hf : f ∈ johnsonHarmonic n M k.1) :
    normalizedKneserAdjacency n M f =
      (((-1 : ℝ) ^ k.1) *
        ((M.descFactorial k.1 : ℝ) / ((n - M).descFactorial k.1 : ℝ))) • f

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.normalizedKneserAdjacency_harmonicProjection
statement:
theorem normalizedKneserAdjacency_harmonicProjection (h2 : 2 * M ≤ n)
    (k : Fin (M + 1)) (f : SliceFn n M) :
    normalizedKneserAdjacency n M (harmonicProjection n M k f) =
      (((-1 : ℝ) ^ k.1) *
        ((M.descFactorial k.1 : ℝ) / ((n - M).descFactorial k.1 : ℝ))) •
        harmonicProjection n M k f

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.normalizedKneser_eigenvalue_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedKneser_eigenvalue_eq (h2 : 2 * M ≤ n)
    (k : Fin (M + 1)) :
    ((n - M).choose M : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((n - M - k.1).choose (M - k.1) : ℝ) =
      (M.descFactorial k.1 : ℝ) / ((n - M).descFactorial k.1 : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Combinatorics.JohnsonScheme.sliceInner_kneserAdjacency
statement:
theorem sliceInner_kneserAdjacency (f g : SliceFn n M) :
    sliceInner (kneserAdjacency n M f) g =
      sliceInner f (kneserAdjacency n M g)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Data.List.get_appendTail
statement:
lemma get_appendTail {V : Type*} (pa q : List V)
    (_hpa : pa ≠ []) (hq : q ≠ []) :
    (pa ++ q.tail).length = pa.length + q.length - 1 ∧
    (∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < pa.length),
      (pa ++ q.tail).get ⟨j, by
        rw [List.length_append]; have := List.length_tail (l := q); omega⟩ = pa.get ⟨j, hj⟩) ∧
    (∀ (j : ℕ) (hjL : pa.length ≤ j) (hj : j < (pa ++ q.tail).length),
      (pa ++ q.tail).get ⟨j, hj⟩ =
        q.get ⟨j - pa.length + 1, by
          rw [List.length_append, List.length_tail] at hj
          have : 1 ≤ q.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hq
          omega⟩)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.EmbeddedNormalGeometry.chartHessian_change
statement:
theorem chartHessian_change (f : M → E)
    (hf : IsSmoothEmbedding I (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) 2 f)
    (φ ψ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M H)
    (hφ : φ ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas I 2 M)
    (hψ : ψ ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas I 2 M)
    (x : M) (hxφ : x ∈ φ.source) (hxψ : x ∈ ψ.source) (v w : F) :
    let q := (φ.extend I) ∘ (ψ.extend I).symm
    let s := (ψ.extend I).target
    let y := (ψ.extend I) x
    let D := fderivWithin ℝ q s y
    let Hq := fderivWithin ℝ (fun z => fderivWithin ℝ q s z) s y
    chartHessian I f ψ x v w = chartHessian I f φ x (D v) (D w) +
      chartDifferential I f φ x (Hq v w)

statement:
theorem exists_secondFundamentalForm (f : M → E)
    (hf : IsSmoothEmbedding I (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) 2 f) (x : M) :
    ∃ B : tangentSpace I f x →L[ℝ] tangentSpace I f x →L[ℝ] normalSpace I f x,
      (∀ v w, B v w = B w v) ∧
      ∀ (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M H) (hφ : φ ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas I 2 M)
        (hx : x ∈ φ.source) (v w : F),
        B (chartTangentVector I f hf φ hφ x hx v)
          (chartTangentVector I f hf φ hφ x hx w) =
        (normalSpace I f x).orthogonalProjectionOnto (chartHessian I f φ x v w)

statement:
theorem secondFundamentalForm_unique (f : M → E)
    (hf : IsSmoothEmbedding I (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) 2 f) (x : M)
    (B : tangentSpace I f x →L[ℝ] tangentSpace I f x →L[ℝ] normalSpace I f x)
    (hB : ∀ (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M H) (hφ : φ ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas I 2 M)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.binomial_inverse_complementary_counts_interior_le
statement:
lemma binomial_inverse_complementary_counts_interior_le
    (m : Nat) (p epsilon : Real)
    (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) (hlo : epsilon ≤ p)
    (hhi : p ≤ 1 - epsilon) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), binomialWeight m p j *
      (if 0 < j ∧ j < m then
        (j : Real)⁻¹ + ((m - j : Nat) : Real)⁻¹
      else 0)) ≤
      4 / (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * epsilon)

    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), binomialWeight m p j *
      (if 0 < j then (j : Real)⁻¹ else 0)) ≤
      2 / (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * p)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.sum_bernoulli_eq_binomial
statement:
lemma sum_bernoulli_eq_binomial {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (p : Real) (F : Nat → Real) :
    (∑ b : ι → Bool, (∏ i, if b i then p else 1 - p) *
      F (Finset.univ.filter fun i => b i = true).card) =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card ι + 1),
      binomialWeight (Fintype.card ι) p j * F j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.clippedStatisticSuccessParameter_abs_sub_le_ae
statement:
lemma clippedStatisticSuccessParameter_abs_sub_le_ae
    {A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    (nu nu' : Measure A) [IsFiniteMeasure nu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu']
    (p p' : A → ℝ) (stat : A → ℝ)
    (hp : Measurable p) (hp' : Measurable p') (hstat : Measurable stat)
    (hp0 : ∀ x, 1 / 4 ≤ p x) (hp1 : ∀ x, p x ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hp0' : ∀ x, 1 / 4 ≤ p' x) (hp1' : ∀ x, p' x ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hmap : Measure.map stat nu = Measure.map stat nu')
    {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) {E : Set ℝ} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hdiff : ∀ B : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet B →
      |(∫ x in {x | stat x ∈ B}, p x ∂nu) -
        ∫ x in {x | stat x ∈ B}, p' x ∂nu'| ≤
          D * (Measure.map stat nu (B ∩ E)).toReal) :
    ∀ᵐ r ∂(Measure.map stat nu),
      |clippedStatisticSuccessParameter nu p stat r -
        clippedStatisticSuccessParameter nu' p' stat r| ≤
          E.indicator (fun _ => D) r

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.commonStatisticBernoulliOutcome_klDiv_le_of_localized_parameter
statement:
lemma commonStatisticBernoulliOutcome_klDiv_le_of_localized_parameter
    (m : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure m] (p q : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hp : Measurable p) (hq : Measurable q)
    (hp0 : ∀ r, 1 / 4 ≤ p r) (hp1 : ∀ r, p r ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hq0 : ∀ r, 1 / 4 ≤ q r) (hq1 : ∀ r, q r ≤ 3 / 4)
    {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) {E : Set ℝ} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hdiff : ∀ᵐ r ∂m, |p r - q r| ≤ E.indicator (fun _ => D) r) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv
        (Measure.map Prod.swap
          (Measure.compProd m (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel p hp)))
        (Measure.map Prod.swap
          (Measure.compProd m (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel q hq))) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (4 * D ^ 2) * m E

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.commonStatisticBernoulli_klDiv_le_of_localized_parameter
statement:
lemma commonStatisticBernoulli_klDiv_le_of_localized_parameter
    (m : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure m] (p q : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hp : Measurable p) (hq : Measurable q)
    (hp0 : ∀ r, 1 / 4 ≤ p r) (hp1 : ∀ r, p r ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hq0 : ∀ r, 1 / 4 ≤ q r) (hq1 : ∀ r, q r ≤ 3 / 4)
    {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) {E : Set ℝ} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hdiff : ∀ᵐ r ∂m, |p r - q r| ≤ E.indicator (fun _ => D) r) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv
        (Measure.compProd m (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel p hp))
        (Measure.compProd m (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel q hq)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (4 * D ^ 2) * m E

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.one_add_mul_one_sub_mem_Icc
Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.statisticBernoulliOutcomeLaw_eq_map_swap_compProd
statement:
lemma statisticBernoulliOutcomeLaw_eq_map_swap_compProd
    {A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] (nu : Measure A) [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    (p : A → ℝ) (stat : A → ℝ) (hp : Measurable p)
    (hstat : Measurable stat) (hp0 : ∀ x, 1 / 4 ≤ p x)
    (hp1 : ∀ x, p x ≤ 3 / 4) :
    Measure.map (fun z : A × ℝ => (z.2, stat z.1))
        (Measure.compProd nu (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel p hp)) =
      Measure.map Prod.swap
        (Measure.compProd (Measure.map stat nu)
          (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel
            (clippedStatisticSuccessParameter nu p stat)
            (clippedStatisticSuccessParameter_measurable nu p stat)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.statisticBernoulliOutcome_klDiv_le_of_localized_success_bound
statement:
lemma statisticBernoulliOutcome_klDiv_le_of_localized_success_bound
    {A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    (nu nu' : Measure A) [IsFiniteMeasure nu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu']
    (p p' : A → ℝ) (stat : A → ℝ)
    (hp : Measurable p) (hp' : Measurable p') (hstat : Measurable stat)
    (hp0 : ∀ x, 1 / 4 ≤ p x) (hp1 : ∀ x, p x ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hp0' : ∀ x, 1 / 4 ≤ p' x) (hp1' : ∀ x, p' x ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hmap : Measure.map stat nu = Measure.map stat nu')
    {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) {E : Set ℝ} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hdiff : ∀ B : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet B →
      |(∫ x in {x | stat x ∈ B}, p x ∂nu) -
        ∫ x in {x | stat x ∈ B}, p' x ∂nu'| ≤
          D * (Measure.map stat nu (B ∩ E)).toReal) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv
        (Measure.map (fun z : A × ℝ => (z.2, stat z.1))
          (Measure.compProd nu (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel p hp)))
        (Measure.map (fun z : A × ℝ => (z.2, stat z.1))
          (Measure.compProd nu' (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel p' hp'))) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (4 * D ^ 2) * Measure.map stat nu E

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.statisticBernoulliOutcome_restrict_compl_eq_of_localized_success_bound
statement:
lemma statisticBernoulliOutcome_restrict_compl_eq_of_localized_success_bound
    {A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    (nu nu' : Measure A) [IsFiniteMeasure nu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu']
    (p p' : A → ℝ) (stat : A → ℝ)
    (hp : Measurable p) (hp' : Measurable p') (hstat : Measurable stat)
    (hp0 : ∀ x, 1 / 4 ≤ p x) (hp1 : ∀ x, p x ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hp0' : ∀ x, 1 / 4 ≤ p' x) (hp1' : ∀ x, p' x ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hmap : Measure.map stat nu = Measure.map stat nu')
    {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) {E : Set ℝ} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hdiff : ∀ B : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet B →
      |(∫ x in {x | stat x ∈ B}, p x ∂nu) -
        ∫ x in {x | stat x ∈ B}, p' x ∂nu'| ≤
          D * (Measure.map stat nu (B ∩ E)).toReal) :
    (Measure.map (fun z : A × ℝ => (z.2, stat z.1))
        (Measure.compProd nu (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel p hp))).restrict
          {z | z.2 ∉ E} =
      (Measure.map (fun z : A × ℝ => (z.2, stat z.1))
        (Measure.compProd nu'
          (commonStatisticBernoulliKernel p' hp'))).restrict
            {z | z.2 ∉ E}

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.statisticSuccessMeasure_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
lemma statisticSuccessMeasure_absolutelyContinuous

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.statisticSuccessParameter_mem_Icc_ae
statement:
lemma statisticSuccessParameter_mem_Icc_ae
    {A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] (nu : Measure A) [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    (p : A → ℝ) (stat : A → ℝ) (hp : Measurable p)

    (hp1 : ∀ x, p x ≤ 3 / 4) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.statisticSuccessParameter_setIntegral
statement:
lemma statisticSuccessParameter_setIntegral

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.entropy_const_eq_log_card
statement:
theorem entropy_const_eq_log_card [Nonempty α] :
    entropy (fun _ : α => (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹) = Real.log (Fintype.card α)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.entropy_def
statement: @[simp] lemma entropy_def (p : α → ℝ) : entropy p = ∑ i, Real.negMulLog (p i)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.entropy_le_log_card
statement:
theorem entropy_le_log_card {p : α → ℝ} (h0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hsum : ∑ i, p i = 1) : entropy p ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card α)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.entropy_nonneg
statement:
lemma entropy_nonneg {p : α → ℝ} (h0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (h1 : ∀ i, p i ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ entropy p

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.negMulLog_sub_mul_log_le
statement:
lemma negMulLog_sub_mul_log_le {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.negMulLog x - x * Real.log c ≤ c⁻¹ - x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.condEntropy_def
statement:
@[simp] lemma condEntropy_def (p : α × β → ℝ) :
    condEntropy p = entropy p - entropy (yMarginal p)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.correctMass_eq
statement:
lemma correctMass_eq {p : α × β → ℝ} (hsum : ∑ xy : α × β, p xy = 1) (decode : β → α) :
    (∑ xy : α × β, (if xy.1 = decode xy.2 then p xy else 0)) = 1 - errorProb p decode

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.entropy_le_crossEntropy
statement:
theorem entropy_le_crossEntropy {γ : Type*} [Fintype γ] {p g : γ → ℝ}
    (hp0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hg0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i) (hgsum : ∑ i, g i ≤ ∑ i, p i)
    (hac : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0 → 0 < g i) :
    entropy p ≤ - ∑ i, p i * Real.log (g i)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.errorProb_def
statement:
@[simp] lemma errorProb_def (p : α × β → ℝ) (decode : β → α) :
    errorProb p decode = ∑ xy : α × β, (if xy.1 = decode xy.2 then 0 else p xy)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.errorProb_le_one
statement:
lemma errorProb_le_one {p : α × β → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ xy, 0 ≤ p xy)
    (hsum : ∑ xy : α × β, p xy = 1) (decode : β → α) :
    errorProb p decode ≤ 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.errorProb_nonneg
statement:
lemma errorProb_nonneg {p : α × β → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ xy, 0 ≤ p xy) (decode : β → α) :
    0 ≤ errorProb p decode

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.le_yMarginal
statement:
lemma le_yMarginal {p : α × β → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ xy, 0 ≤ p xy) (x : α) (y : β) :
    p (x, y) ≤ yMarginal p y

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.negMulLog_add_mul_log_le
statement:
lemma negMulLog_add_mul_log_le {x g : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hg : 0 ≤ g)
    (hac : x ≠ 0 → 0 < g) :
    Real.negMulLog x + x * Real.log g ≤ g - x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.yMarginal_def
statement:
@[simp] lemma yMarginal_def (p : α × β → ℝ) (y : β) :
    yMarginal p y = ∑ x, p (x, y)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.yMarginal_nonneg
statement:
lemma yMarginal_nonneg {p : α × β → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ xy, 0 ≤ p xy) (y : β) :
    0 ≤ yMarginal p y

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.yMarginal_sum
statement:
lemma yMarginal_sum {p : α × β → ℝ} (hsum : ∑ xy : α × β, p xy = 1) :
    ∑ y, yMarginal p y = 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.fanoRef_ac
statement:
lemma fanoRef_ac {p : α × β → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ xy, 0 ≤ p xy)
    (hsum : ∑ xy : α × β, p xy = 1) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card α) (decode : β → α)
    (xy : α × β) (hxy : p xy ≠ 0) : 0 < fanoRef p decode xy

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.fanoRef_def
statement:
@[simp] lemma fanoRef_def (p : α × β → ℝ) (decode : β → α) (xy : α × β) :
    fanoRef p decode xy =
      yMarginal p xy.2 *
        (if xy.1 = decode xy.2 then 1 - errorProb p decode
          else errorProb p decode / ((Fintype.card α : ℝ) - 1))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.fanoRef_nonneg
statement:
lemma fanoRef_nonneg {p : α × β → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ xy, 0 ≤ p xy)
    (hsum : ∑ xy : α × β, p xy = 1) (decode : β → α)
    (xy : α × β) : 0 ≤ fanoRef p decode xy

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.fanoRef_sum_eq_one
Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.fano_error_lower_bound
statement:
theorem fano_error_lower_bound {p : α × β → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ xy, 0 ≤ p xy)
    (hsum : ∑ xy : α × β, p xy = 1) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card α) (decode : β → α) :
    (condEntropy p - Real.log 2) / Real.log (Fintype.card α) ≤ errorProb p decode

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.fano_inequality
statement:
theorem fano_inequality {p : α × β → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ xy, 0 ≤ p xy)
    (hsum : ∑ xy : α × β, p xy = 1) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card α) (decode : β → α) :
    condEntropy p ≤ Real.binEntropy (errorProb p decode)
      + errorProb p decode * Real.log ((Fintype.card α : ℝ) - 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.neg_crossEntropy_fanoRef
statement:
lemma neg_crossEntropy_fanoRef {p : α × β → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ xy, 0 ≤ p xy)
    (hsum : ∑ xy : α × β, p xy = 1) (hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card α) (decode : β → α) :
    (- ∑ xy : α × β, p xy * Real.log (fanoRef p decode xy))
      = entropy (yMarginal p) + Real.binEntropy (errorProb p decode)
          + errorProb p decode * Real.log ((Fintype.card α : ℝ) - 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.klDiv_toReal_eq_sum_measureReal
statement:
theorem klDiv_toReal_eq_sum_measureReal
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (μ ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) :
    (_root_.InformationTheory.klDiv μ ν).toReal =
      ∑ x : α, μ.real {x} * Real.log (μ.real {x} / ν.real {x})

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.uniform_condEntropy_kl_identity
statement:
theorem uniform_condEntropy_kl_identity
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty α]
    (r : α → β → ℝ) (hr0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ r i y)
    (hrsum : ∀ i, ∑ y, r i y = 1) :
    Real.log (Fintype.card α) -
        condEntropy
          (fun z : α × β => (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ * r z.1 z.2) =
      (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ i, ∑ y, r i y *
          Real.log
            (r i y /
              ((Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, r k y))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.uniform_information_le_average_logRatio
statement:
theorem uniform_information_le_average_logRatio
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty α]
    (r : α → β → ℝ) (hr0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ r i y)
    (hrsum : ∀ i, ∑ y, r i y = 1)
    (q : β → ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ q y) (hqsum : ∑ y, q y = 1)
    (hac : ∀ i y, r i y ≠ 0 → q y ≠ 0) :
    (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ i, ∑ y, r i y *
          Real.log
            (r i y / ((Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k, r k y)) ≤
      (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ i, ∑ y, r i y * Real.log (r i y / q y)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.klDiv_map_measurableEquiv
statement:
lemma klDiv_map_measurableEquiv {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (e : α ≃ᵐ β) (μ ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    InformationTheory.klDiv (Measure.map e μ) (Measure.map e ν) =

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.twoPointMean_coef_nonneg
statement:
lemma twoPointMean_coef_nonneg {B u : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) (hu : |u| ≤ B) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.absolutelyContinuous_of_strictlyPositivePMF
Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.appendSymbol_eq_snoc
statement:
theorem appendSymbol_eq_snoc {k : Nat} (u : Fin k → Ω) (x : Ω) :
    appendSymbol u x = Fin.snoc (α := fun _ ↦ Ω) u x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.conditionalKL_eq_sum
statement:
lemma conditionalKL_eq_sum {k : Nat} (p q : PMF (Fin (k + 1) → Ω))
    (hac : ∀ u, (nextSymbolPMF p u).toMeasure ≪ (nextSymbolPMF q u).toMeasure) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv
        ((prefixPMF p).toMeasure.compProd (nextSymbolKernel p))
        ((prefixPMF p).toMeasure.compProd (nextSymbolKernel q)) =
      ∑ u : Fin k → Ω, prefixPMF p u *
        InformationTheory.klDiv (nextSymbolPMF p u).toMeasure
          (nextSymbolPMF q u).toMeasure

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.klDiv_eq_chainKL
statement:
lemma klDiv_eq_chainKL (k : Nat) (p q : PMF (Fin k → Ω)) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv p.toMeasure q.toMeasure = chainKL k p q

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.klDiv_lastCoordinate_eq_add
statement:
lemma klDiv_lastCoordinate_eq_add {k : Nat} (p q : PMF (Fin (k + 1) → Ω)) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv p.toMeasure q.toMeasure =
      InformationTheory.klDiv (prefixPMF p).toMeasure (prefixPMF q).toMeasure +
        InformationTheory.klDiv
          ((prefixPMF p).toMeasure.compProd (nextSymbolKernel p))
          ((prefixPMF p).toMeasure.compProd (nextSymbolKernel q))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.klDiv_lastCoordinate_eq_add_sum
statement:
lemma klDiv_lastCoordinate_eq_add_sum {k : Nat} (p q : PMF (Fin (k + 1) → Ω))
    (hac : ∀ u, (nextSymbolPMF p u).toMeasure ≪ (nextSymbolPMF q u).toMeasure) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv p.toMeasure q.toMeasure =
      InformationTheory.klDiv (prefixPMF p).toMeasure (prefixPMF q).toMeasure +
        ∑ u : Fin k → Ω, prefixPMF p u *
          InformationTheory.klDiv (nextSymbolPMF p u).toMeasure
            (nextSymbolPMF q u).toMeasure

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.klDiv_lastCoordinate_eq_add_sum_of_fullSupport
statement:
lemma klDiv_lastCoordinate_eq_add_sum_of_fullSupport {k : Nat}
    (p q : PMF (Fin (k + 1) → Ω)) (hp : ∀ w, 0 < p w) (hq : ∀ w, 0 < q w) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv p.toMeasure q.toMeasure =
      InformationTheory.klDiv (prefixPMF p).toMeasure (prefixPMF q).toMeasure +

            (nextSymbolPMF q u).toMeasure

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.lastCoordinateSplit_compProd
statement:
lemma lastCoordinateSplit_compProd {k : Nat} (p : PMF (Fin (k + 1) → Ω)) :

statement:
lemma nextSymbolPMF_absolutelyContinuous {k : Nat}
    {p q : PMF (Fin (k + 1) → Ω)} (hp : ∀ w, 0 < p w) (hq : ∀ w, 0 < q w)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.prefixPMF_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma prefixPMF_apply {k : Nat} (p : PMF (Fin (k + 1) → Ω)) (u : Fin k → Ω) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.prefixPMF_fullSupport

lemma prefixPMF_fullSupport {k : Nat} {p : PMF (Fin (k + 1) → Ω)}

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.FiniteWordChainRule.prefix_mul_nextSymbol
statement:
lemma prefix_mul_nextSymbol {k : Nat} (p : PMF (Fin (k + 1) → Ω))

    prefixPMF p u * nextSymbolPMF p u x = p (appendSymbol u x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.gaussianKL_eq
statement:
theorem gaussianKL_eq (m₀ m₁ : ℝ) (hv : 0 < v) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv (gaussianReal m₀ v) (gaussianReal m₁ v)
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((m₀ - m₁) ^ 2 / (2 * (v : ℝ)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.gaussianReal_ac_gaussianReal
Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.gaussianReal_klDiv_eq_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gaussianReal_klDiv_eq_of_ne_zero (m₀ m₁ : ℝ) (v : ℝ≥0) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv (gaussianReal m₀ v) (gaussianReal m₁ v) =

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.integrable_llr_gaussianReal
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma integrable_llr_gaussianReal (m₀ m₁ : ℝ) (hv : v ≠ 0) :

lemma integral_llr_gaussianReal (m₀ m₁ : ℝ) (hv : v ≠ 0) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.llr_gaussianReal_ae

    llr (gaussianReal m₀ v) (gaussianReal m₁ v)
      =ᵐ[gaussianReal m₀ v]

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.rnDeriv_toReal_gaussianReal_ae

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.KullbackLeibler.DensityTilt.abs_tiltRemainder_le
statement:
lemma abs_tiltRemainder_le {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |(1 + x) * Real.log (1 + x) - x - x ^ 2 / 2| ≤ |x| ^ 3

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.KullbackLeibler.DensityTilt.abs_klRemainder_le
statement:
lemma abs_klRemainder_le {μ : Measure Z} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {s : Z → ℝ}
    {C h : ℝ} (hs_meas : Measurable s) (hsC : ∀ y, |s y| ≤ C)
    (hs_mean : ∫ y, s y ∂μ = 0) (hh : |h| * C ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |(InformationTheory.klDiv (tiltMeasure μ s h) μ).toReal
        - (h ^ 2 / 2) * ∫ y, s y ^ 2 ∂μ| ≤ C ^ 3 * |h| ^ 3

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.KullbackLeibler.DensityTilt.klDiv_tiltMeasure_toReal_eq
statement:
lemma klDiv_tiltMeasure_toReal_eq {μ : Measure Z} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {s : Z → ℝ}
    {C h : ℝ} (hs_meas : Measurable s) (hsC : ∀ y, |s y| ≤ C) (hs_mean : ∫ y, s y ∂μ = 0)
    (hh : |h| * C ≤ 1) :
    (InformationTheory.klDiv (tiltMeasure μ s h) μ).toReal
      = ∫ y, (1 + h * s y) * Real.log (1 + h * s y) ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.InformationTheory.KullbackLeibler.DensityTilt.klDiv_tilt_expansion
statement:
theorem klDiv_tilt_expansion {μ : Measure Z} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {s : Z → ℝ}
    {C : ℝ} (hs_meas : Measurable s) (hsC : ∀ y, |s y| ≤ C) (hs_mean : ∫ y, s y ∂μ = 0) :
    (fun h => (InformationTheory.klDiv (tiltMeasure μ s h) μ).toReal
        - (h ^ 2 / 2) * ∫ y, s y ^ 2 ∂μ)
      =o[𝓝 0] (fun h => h ^ 2)

theorem rnDeriv_prod_eq (μ₁ ν₁ : Measure α) (μ₂ ν₂ : Measure β)

    [μ₁.HaveLebesgueDecomposition ν₁] [μ₂.HaveLebesgueDecomposition ν₂]
    (h₁ : μ₁ ≪ ν₁) (h₂ : μ₂ ≪ ν₂) :
    (μ₁.prod μ₂).rnDeriv (ν₁.prod ν₂)

statement:

    (n : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hac : μ ≪ ν) (hint : Integrable (llr μ ν) μ)
    (hπac : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => μ) ≪ Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν))
    (hπint : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Integrable
        (llr (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => μ)) (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.exists_local_anchoredSolution_of_rightInverse
statement:
theorem exists_local_anchoredSolution_of_rightInverse
    (A : X → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ) (b : X → Fin k → ℝ)
    (R₀ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (x₀ : X) (y₀ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hA : Continuous A) (hb : Continuous b)
    (hR : A x₀ * R₀ = 1) (hy : A x₀ *ᵥ y₀ = b x₀) :
    ∃ s : Set X, IsOpen s ∧ x₀ ∈ s ∧
      ContinuousOn (anchoredSolution A b R₀ y₀) s ∧
      anchoredSolution A b R₀ y₀ x₀ = y₀ ∧
      ∀ x ∈ s, A x *ᵥ anchoredSolution A b R₀ y₀ x = b x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.exists_local_anchoredSolution_of_surjective

theorem exists_local_anchoredSolution_of_surjective
    (A : X → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ) (b : X → Fin k → ℝ)
    (x₀ : X) (y₀ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hA : Continuous A) (hb : Continuous b)
    (hfull : Function.Surjective (A x₀).mulVec)
    (hy : A x₀ *ᵥ y₀ = b x₀) :
    ∃ (s : Set X) (y : X → Fin n → ℝ),
      IsOpen s ∧ x₀ ∈ s ∧ ContinuousOn y s ∧
      y x₀ = y₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, A x *ᵥ y x = b x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.NormalEquations.lstsq_pythagoras
statement:
theorem lstsq_pythagoras {N : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {Φ : Fin N → ι → ℝ} {w Y : Fin N → ℝ} {c : ι → ℝ}
    (hortho : ∀ k : ι, ∑ i, w i * lstsqResidual Φ Y c i * Φ i k = 0)
    (c' : ι → ℝ) :
    lstsqObjective Φ w Y c'
      = lstsqObjective Φ w Y c + ∑ i, w i * (∑ j, (c j - c' j) * Φ i j) ^ 2

statement:
theorem finite_positive_perron_eigenvector
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA_symm : A.IsSymm) (hA_irred : A.IsIrreducible) :
    ∃ (v : EVec ι) (ρ : ℝ),
      ‖v‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < v i) ∧
      A.mulVec v = ρ • v ∧
      rayleighForm A v = ρ ∧
      ρ = sphereRayleighValue A ∧
      ρ = coordinateSphereRayleighValue A ∧
      ρ = iSupRayleighValue A

    (hA_irred : (restrictMatrix A s).IsIrreducible)
    (hclosed : ∀ i j, i ∉ s → j ∈ s → A i j = 0) :
    ∃ (v : EVec s) (ρ : ℝ),
      ‖v‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < v i) ∧
      (restrictMatrix A s).mulVec v = ρ • v ∧
      A.mulVec (zeroExtendVec s v) = ρ • zeroExtendVec s v ∧
      ρ = sphereRayleighValue (restrictMatrix A s) ∧
      ρ = coordinateSphereRayleighValue (restrictMatrix A s) ∧
      ρ = iSupRayleighValue (restrictMatrix A s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Tensor.SymmetricPencil.contractLast_decompositionTensor
statement:
-- Proof route: ext the two free multi-indices, unfold both matrix products and the tensor sum,
-- swap finite sums, and factor each probe sum into a dot product.
theorem contractLast_decompositionTensor {p n d q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (C : FactorMatrix p n) (lam : Fin n → ℝ) (u w : Vec p) :
    contractLast (decompositionTensor (d + d + q) C lam) (pencilProbes u w) =
      liftedDirections d C * Matrix.diagonal (fun j =>
        lam j * dot u (C.col j) ^ (q - 1) * dot w (C.col j)) *
          (liftedDirections d C).transpose

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Tensor.SymmetricPencil.contractLast_frobeniusNorm_le
statement:
-- Proof route: identify each contraction as an inner product in the product probe index,
-- apply finite Cauchy--Schwarz, and sum the squared bounds over the two free index blocks.
theorem contractLast_frobeniusNorm_le {p d q : ℕ} (T : Tensor p (d + d + q))
    (probes : Fin q → Vec p)
    (hprobes : ∀ a, finiteFrobeniusNorm (probes a) ≤ 1) :
    matrixFrobeniusNorm (contractLast T probes) ≤ finiteFrobeniusNorm T

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Tensor.SymmetricPencil.contractLast_operatorNorm_le
statement:
-- Proof route: first bound the square-matrix operator norm by its Frobenius norm, then invoke
-- `contractLast_frobeniusNorm_le`.
theorem contractLast_operatorNorm_le {p d q : ℕ} (T : Tensor p (d + d + q))
    (probes : Fin q → Vec p)
    (hprobes : ∀ a, finiteFrobeniusNorm (probes a) ≤ 1) :
    squareOperatorNorm (contractLast T probes) ≤ finiteFrobeniusNorm T

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Tensor.SymmetricPencil.finiteFrobeniusNorm_liftedColumn_eq_one
statement:
-- Proof route: square the norm, factor the sum over functions `Fin d → Fin p` as a product of
-- coordinate sums, and use the unit-column hypothesis in every factor.
theorem finiteFrobeniusNorm_liftedColumn_eq_one {p n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (C : FactorMatrix p n) (hunit : ∀ j, finiteFrobeniusNorm (C.col j) = 1) (j : Fin n) :
    finiteFrobeniusNorm ((liftedDirections d C).col j) = 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Tensor.SymmetricPencil.matrixFrobeniusNorm_liftedDirections
statement:
-- Proof route: regroup the matrix sum by columns and use
-- `finiteFrobeniusNorm_liftedColumn_eq_one`.
theorem matrixFrobeniusNorm_liftedDirections {p n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (C : FactorMatrix p n) (hunit : ∀ j, finiteFrobeniusNorm (C.col j) = 1) :
    matrixFrobeniusNorm (liftedDirections d C) = Real.sqrt n

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Tensor.SymmetricPencil.squareOperatorNorm_le_matrixFrobenius
statement:
theorem squareOperatorNorm_le_matrixFrobenius {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : squareOperatorNorm A ≤ matrixFrobeniusNorm A

name: Causalean.Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Tensor.SymmetricPencil.injective_of_pos_le_leastColumnSingularValue
statement:
-- Proof route: positivity rules out
-- `singularValues_eq_zero_iff_le_finrank_range` at the last domain index.  Hence the range has
-- full domain finrank, so rank--nullity makes the kernel trivial.  (The existing expansion lemma
-- itself assumes injectivity, so it cannot be used contrapositively here.)
theorem injective_of_pos_le_leastColumnSingularValue {ι κ : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Nonempty κ]
    (A : Matrix ι κ ℝ) {sigma : ℝ} (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hsv : sigma ≤ leastColumnSingularValue A) :
    Function.Injective A.toEuclideanLin

statement:
theorem condExp_expTilt_ae_eq_div [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} (hm : m ≤ m₀) {s f : Ω → ℝ} (t : ℝ)
    (hs_meas : @Measurable Ω ℝ m₀ _ s) (hs_bound : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, |s x| ≤ C)
    (hf : Integrable f (μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal
      (Real.exp (t * s x) / ∫ y, Real.exp (t * s y) ∂μ))) :
    @MeasureTheory.condExp Ω ℝ m m₀ _ _ (μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal
      (Real.exp (t * s x) / ∫ y, Real.exp (t * s y) ∂μ)) f =ᵐ[μ]
      fun x =>
        μ[fun y => f y * (Real.exp (t * s y) / ∫ z, Real.exp (t * s z) ∂μ) | m] x /
          μ[fun y => Real.exp (t * s y) / ∫ z, Real.exp (t * s z) ∂μ | m] x

    (hw_norm : ∫ x, w x ∂μ = 1)

    @MeasureTheory.condExp Ω ℝ m m₀ _ _
      (μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)) f =ᵐ[
      μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)]
      fun x => μ[fun y => f y * w y | m] x / μ[w | m] x

    {φ : Ω → R} {ψ : Ω' → R} (hφ : Measurable φ) (hψ : Measurable ψ)

    (ho : ∀ a b, (∫ x, f a x * f b x ∂μ) = if a = b then A else 0) :

    (hortho : ∀ i j, (∫ x, b i x * b j x ∂μ) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 μ) :
    let g := fun x => ∑ i, b i x * (∫ y, b i y * f y ∂μ)
    (∫ x, f x^2 ∂μ) = (∫ x, g x^2 ∂μ) + (∫ x, (f x-g x)^2 ∂μ)

name: MeasureTheory.rnDeriv_compProd_prod_sigmaFinite

lemma rnDeriv_compProd_prod_sigmaFinite

    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (hfiber : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a ≪ ρ)
    (hfiber_meas :
      AEMeasurable (fun p : α × β => (κ p.1).rnDeriv ρ p.2) (ν.prod ρ))
    (hf : μ.rnDeriv ν =ᵐ[ν] f) :
    (μ ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν.prod ρ)
      =ᵐ[ν.prod ρ] fun p => f p.1 * (κ p.1).rnDeriv ρ p.2

    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace Y]
    (m n : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure m] [IsFiniteMeasure n]
    (hmn : m ≪ n) (S : Set X) (T : Set Y)
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hT : MeasurableSet T)
    (hμS : m Sᶜ = 0) (hνS : n Sᶜ = 0)
    (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X)
    (hf : SupportMeasurableOn f S) (hg : SupportMeasurableOn g T)
    (hfT : ∀ x ∈ S, f x ∈ T)
    (hgS : ∀ y ∈ T, g y ∈ S)
    (hgf : ∀ x ∈ S, g (f x) = x)
    (hfg : ∀ y ∈ T, f (g y) = y) :
    Measure.map (fun x ↦ (m.rnDeriv n x).toReal) n =
      Measure.map (fun y ↦ ((m.map f).rnDeriv (n.map f) y).toReal) (n.map f)

theorem independent_channel_mark_restrict_cond
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (U : Ω → AddCircle T) (R : Ω → L) (M : L → β)
    (hU : Measurable U) (hR : Measurable R) (hM : Measurable M)
    (hind : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun U R P)
    (A : Set L) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hpos : P (R ⁻¹' A) ≠ 0)
    (B : Set β) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    ((ProbabilityTheory.cond P (R ⁻¹' A)).map
      (fun ω => (U ω, M (R ω)))).restrict (Prod.snd ⁻¹' B) =
      (P.map U).prod
        (((ProbabilityTheory.cond P (R ⁻¹' A)).map (M ∘ R)).restrict B)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Optimization.finite_knapsack_attains
statement:
lemma finite_knapsack_attains {d : ℕ} (p tau : Fin d → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    ∃ pi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      (∀ j, pi j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      (∑ j, p j * pi j) ≤ b ∧
      ∀ rho : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
        (∀ j, rho j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∑ j, p j * rho j) ≤ b →
        (∑ j, p j * rho j * tau j) ≤ ∑ j, p j * pi j * tau j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Optimization.exists_boundary_perturbation
statement:
theorem exists_boundary_perturbation {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (x d : ι → ℝ) (hxnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hdnonzero : d ≠ 0) (hsupp : ∀ i, x i = 0 → d i = 0) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i + t * d i) ∧
      (weightSupport (fun i => x i + t * d i)).card < (weightSupport x).card

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Optimization.exists_kernel_direction
statement:
theorem exists_kernel_direction {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (A : κ → ι → ℝ) (g : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ)
    (hlarge : Fintype.card κ + 1 < (weightSupport x).card) :
    ∃ d : ι → ℝ, d ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, x i = 0 → d i = 0) ∧
      (∀ k, moment (A k) d = 0) ∧ moment g d = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Optimization.exists_sparse_maximizer
statement:
theorem exists_sparse_maximizer {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (A : κ → ι → ℝ) (b : κ → ℝ) (g c x : ι → ℝ)
    (hxnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hxmoment : ∀ k, moment (A k) x = b k)
    (hmax : ∀ z : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) →
      (∀ k, moment (A k) z = b k) → moment c z ≤ moment c x) :
    ∃ y : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) ∧
      (∀ k, moment (A k) y = b k) ∧
      moment g y = moment g x ∧
      moment c y = moment c x ∧
      (weightSupport y).card ≤ Fintype.card κ + 1 ∧
      (∀ z : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) →
        (∀ k, moment (A k) z = b k) → moment c z ≤ moment c y)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Optimization.objective_orthogonal_of_maximal
statement:
theorem objective_orthogonal_of_maximal {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (A : κ → ι → ℝ) (b : κ → ℝ) (c x d : ι → ℝ)
    (hxnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (hxmoment : ∀ k, moment (A k) x = b k)
    (hmax : ∀ z : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) →
      (∀ k, moment (A k) z = b k) → moment c z ≤ moment c x)
    (hsupp : ∀ i, x i = 0 → d i = 0)
    (hkernel : ∀ k, moment (A k) d = 0) :
    moment c d = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Optimization.RationalLP.eliminateAll_iff
statement:
theorem eliminateAll_iff {n : ℕ} {rows : List (AugmentedIneq n)} {t : ℚ} :
    (∃ x : Fin n → ℚ, ∀ r ∈ rows, r.Holds x t) ↔
      ∀ r ∈ eliminateAll n rows, r.Holds Fin.elim0 t

      ∀ r ∈ eliminateOne rows, r.Holds x t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Optimization.RationalLP.exists_rational_optimal_primal_dual
statement:
theorem exists_rational_optimal_primal_dual (P : Program ι n)
    (hne : ∃ x, P.PrimalFeasible x)
    (hbdd : ∃ l : ℚ, ∀ x, P.PrimalFeasible x → l ≤ P.objective x) :
    ∃ (xStar : Fin n → ℚ) (yStar : ι → ℚ),
      P.PrimalFeasible xStar ∧ P.DualFeasible yStar ∧
      P.objective xStar = P.dualObjective yStar ∧
      ∀ x, P.PrimalFeasible x → P.objective xStar ≤ P.objective x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.binomialAverage_pairs

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.binomialAverage_centered_sq
statement:
theorem binomialAverage_centered_sq (T : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) :
    binomialAverage T eta (fun r => ((r : ℝ) - mean T eta) ^ 2) =
      mean T eta * (1 - eta)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.binomialAverage_deviation_le
statement:
theorem binomialAverage_deviation_le (T : ℕ) {eta a : ℝ}
    (heta : eta ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (ha : 0 < a) :
    binomialAverage T eta
        (fun r => if a ≤ |(r : ℝ) - mean T eta| then 1 else 0) ≤
      mean T eta * (1 - eta) / a ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.binomialAverage_mono

theorem binomialAverage_mono (T : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (f g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (heta : eta ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.binomialAverage_nonneg

theorem binomialAverage_nonneg (T : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.binomial_relative_deviation_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem binomial_relative_deviation_tendsto_zero
    (Tseq : ℕ → ℕ) (etaseq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (heta : ∀ j, etaseq j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : Tendsto (fun j => mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j)) atTop atTop)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    Tendsto
      (fun j => binomialAverage (Tseq j) (etaseq j)
        (fun r => if eps * mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j) ≤
          |(r : ℝ) - mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j)| then 1 else 0))
      atTop (nhds 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.repeat_le_pairScale_div

    (hm : 0 < m) (heta : eta ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.binomialAverage_tendsto_of_relative_band
statement:
theorem binomialAverage_tendsto_of_relative_band
    (Tseq : ℕ → ℕ) (etaseq : ℕ → ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (heta : ∀ j, etaseq j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : Tendsto (fun j => mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j)) atTop atTop)
    (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hbound : ∀ j r, r ≤ Tseq j → f j r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hband : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ Tseq j →
        |(r : ℝ) - mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j)| <
          ε * mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j) → |f j r - c| ≤ δ) :
    Tendsto (fun j => binomialAverage (Tseq j) (etaseq j) (f j)) atTop (nhds c)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.pairScale_div_half_mean_sq_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem pairScale_div_half_mean_sq_tendsto_one
    (Tseq : ℕ → ℕ) (etaseq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (heta : ∀ j, etaseq j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : Tendsto (fun j => mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j)) atTop atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun j => pairScale (Tseq j) (etaseq j) /
      (mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j) ^ 2 / 2)) atTop (nhds 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.mean_div_alphabet_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem mean_div_alphabet_tendsto_zero
    (Tseq mseq : ℕ → ℕ) (etaseq : ℕ → ℝ) {q : ℝ}
    (heta : ∀ j, etaseq j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : Tendsto (fun j => mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j)) atTop atTop)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < mseq j)
    (hscale : Tendsto
      (fun j => pairScale (Tseq j) (etaseq j) / (mseq j : ℝ)) atTop (nhds q))
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    Tendsto (fun j => mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j) / (mseq j : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.pairCount_div_alphabet_uniform_on_relative_band
statement:
theorem pairCount_div_alphabet_uniform_on_relative_band
    (Tseq mseq : ℕ → ℕ) (etaseq : ℕ → ℝ) {q : ℝ}
    (heta : ∀ j, etaseq j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : Tendsto (fun j => mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j)) atTop atTop)
    (hm : ∀ j, 0 < mseq j)
    (hscale : Tendsto
      (fun j => pairScale (Tseq j) (etaseq j) / (mseq j : ℝ)) atTop (nhds q))
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ r : ℕ,
        |(r : ℝ) - mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j)| <
          ε * mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j) →
        |(r.choose 2 : ℝ) / (mseq j : ℝ) - q| ≤ δ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.pairCount_div_remaining_uniform_on_relative_band
statement:
theorem pairCount_div_remaining_uniform_on_relative_band
    (Tseq mseq : ℕ → ℕ) (etaseq : ℕ → ℝ) {q : ℝ}

          ε * mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j) →

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Birthday.repeat_tendsto
statement:
theorem repeat_tendsto
    (Tseq mseq : ℕ → ℕ) (etaseq : ℕ → ℝ) {q : ℝ}

statement:
theorem pairScale_div_positiveCeil_tendsto
    (Tseq : ℕ → ℕ) (etaseq : ℕ → ℝ) {delta c : ℝ}
    (heta : ∀ j, etaseq j ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : Tendsto (fun j => mean (Tseq j) (etaseq j)) atTop atTop)
    (hdelta : delta ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun j => pairScale (Tseq j) (etaseq j) /

      atTop (nhds ((-Real.log (1 - delta)) / c))

statement:

    (Tseq : ℕ → ℕ) (etaseq : ℕ → ℝ) {delta : ℝ}

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {P Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {p0P p0Q : RationalProbabilityVector ι}
    {reward : ι → ℝ}
    (kernelP : CertifiedKernel P) (kernelQ : CertifiedKernel Q)
    (iterateP : FiniteIterateCertificate kernelP.intervals p0P)
    (iterateQ : FiniteIterateCertificate kernelQ.intervals p0Q)
    (rewardCert : BoundedRewardCertificate reward)
    (rhoP rhoQ : ℚ)
    (hrhoP0 : 0 ≤ rhoP) (hrhoP1 : rhoP < 1)
    (hrhoQ0 : 0 ≤ rhoQ) (hrhoQ1 : rhoQ < 1)
    (hcontractP : ContractsL1 P (rhoP : ℝ))
    (hcontractQ : ContractsL1 Q (rhoQ : ℝ))
    {πP πQ : ι → ℝ} (hπP : IsStationary P πP) (hπQ : IsStationary Q πQ)
    {benchmark : ℝ}
    (hsep :
      (stationaryRewardInterval iterateP rewardCert rhoP hrhoP0 hrhoP1).hi <
      (stationaryRewardInterval iterateQ rewardCert rhoQ hrhoQ0 hrhoQ1).lo) :
    stationaryBias πP reward benchmark < stationaryBias πQ reward benchmark

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.CertifiedFiniteMarkovExpectation.normalDensityNode_sound

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.CertifiedFiniteMarkovExpectation.normalDensityScaleInterval_sound

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.CertifiedFiniteMarkovExpectation.rescaledNormalDensity_lipschitz
statement:
theorem rescaledNormalDensity_lipschitz (q : ℚ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ v ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      |(q : ℝ) * Causalean.Mathlib.stdNormalPDF ((q : ℝ) * u) -
          (q : ℝ) * Causalean.Mathlib.stdNormalPDF ((q : ℝ) * v)|
        ≤ (q ^ 3 : ℚ) * |u - v|

statement:
theorem stdNormalCDF_eq_half_add_rescaled_integral (q : ℚ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    Causalean.Mathlib.stdNormalCDF (q : ℝ) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) + ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        (q : ℝ) * Causalean.Mathlib.stdNormalPDF ((q : ℝ) * u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.CertifiedFiniteMarkovExpectation.CertifiedNormalCDFEnclosure.central_or_tail
statement:

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.CertifiedFiniteMarkovExpectation.CertifiedNormalCDFEnclosure.gaussianIntegralMagnitude_nonneg

theorem gaussianIntegralMagnitude_nonneg (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (k : ℕ) :

theorem gaussianIntegralRemainder_geometric (x : ℚ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x)

    gaussianIntegralRemainder x (64 + j) ≤

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.CertifiedFiniteMarkovExpectation.CertifiedNormalCDFEnclosure.gaussianIntegralRemainder_geometric_step
statement:
theorem gaussianIntegralRemainder_geometric_step (x : ℚ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.CertifiedFiniteMarkovExpectation.CertifiedNormalCDFEnclosure.gaussianIntegral_hasSum
statement:

statement:

statement:

statement:

Causalean.Mathlib.covariance_sq_le_variance_mul
Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integral_eventSelectedMixture
statement:
lemma integral_eventSelectedMixture {J E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSpace E]
    (μJ : Measure J) (μE : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μJ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μE] (A : Set J) (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    (P H : E → Real) (hP : Integrable P μE) (hH : Integrable H μE) :
    ∫ z, eventSelectedMixture A P H z ∂μJ.prod μE =
      μJ.real A * (∫ e, P e ∂μE) +
        (1 - μJ.real A) * (∫ e, H e ∂μE)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integral_eventSelectedMixture_sq
statement:
lemma integral_eventSelectedMixture_sq {J E : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSpace E]
    (μJ : Measure J) (μE : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μJ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μE] (A : Set J) (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    (P H : E → Real) (hP : MemLp P 2 μE) (hH : MemLp H 2 μE) :
    ∫ z, eventSelectedMixture A P H z ^ 2 ∂μJ.prod μE =
      μJ.real A * (∫ e, P e ^ 2 ∂μE) +
        (1 - μJ.real A) * (∫ e, H e ^ 2 ∂μE)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.memLp_eventSelectedMixture
statement:
lemma memLp_eventSelectedMixture {J E : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSpace E]
    (μJ : Measure J) (μE : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μJ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μE]
    (A : Set J) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (P H : E → Real)
    (hP : MemLp P 2 μE) (hH : MemLp H 2 μE) :
    MemLp (eventSelectedMixture A P H) 2 (μJ.prod μE)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.memLp_mul_prod_two
statement:
lemma memLp_mul_prod_two {S K : Type*} [Countable S] [Countable K]
    [MeasurableSpace S] [MeasurableSpace K]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass S] [MeasurableSingletonClass K]
    {muS : Measure S} {muK : Measure K} {f : S → Real} {g : K → Real}
    (hf : MemLp f 2 muS) (hg : MemLp g 2 muK) :
    MemLp (fun z : S × K ↦ f z.1 * g z.2) 2 (muS.prod muK)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.variance_eventSelectedMixture
statement:
lemma variance_eventSelectedMixture {J E : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSpace E]
    (μJ : Measure J) (μE : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μJ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μE] (A : Set J) (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    (P H : E → Real) (hP : MemLp P 2 μE) (hH : MemLp H 2 μE) :
    Var[eventSelectedMixture A P H; μJ.prod μE] =
      μJ.real A * Var[P; μE] + (1 - μJ.real A) * Var[H; μE] +
        μJ.real A * (1 - μJ.real A) *
          ((∫ e, P e ∂μE) - ∫ e, H e ∂μE) ^ 2

name: ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.integral_restrict_preimage_eq_mul
statement:
theorem IndepFun.integral_restrict_preimage_eq_mul
    {Ω α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    {μ : Measure Ω}
    {f : Ω → α} {g : Ω → β} (hfg : IndepFun f g μ)
    (hf_ae : AEMeasurable f μ) (hg : AEMeasurable g μ)
    {E : Set α} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hpre : MeasurableSet (f ⁻¹' E))
    {h : β → ℝ} (hh : AEStronglyMeasurable h (μ.map g)) :
    ∫ ω in f ⁻¹' E, h (g ω) ∂μ
      = (μ (f ⁻¹' E)).toReal * ∫ ω, h (g ω) ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.eventCondExp_add

lemma eventCondExp_add (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Set Ω)

    (h₁ : IntegrableOn g₁ A μ) (h₂ : IntegrableOn g₂ A μ) :
    normalizedRestrictedIntegral μ A (g₁ + g₂) =

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.eventCondExp_congr_ae
Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.eventCondExp_congr_on

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.eventCondExp_eq
statement:
lemma eventCondExp_eq (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Set Ω) (g : Ω → ℝ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.eventCondExp_eq_sum_condProb_mul_eventCondExp
statement:
lemma eventCondExp_eq_sum_condProb_mul_eventCondExp
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (A : Set Ω) (C : ι → Set Ω) (hAmeas : MeasurableSet A)
    (hCmeas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (C i))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint C))
    (hcov : (⋃ i, C i) = Set.univ)
    (hAC_fin : ∀ i, μ (A ∩ C i) ≠ ⊤)
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    normalizedRestrictedIntegral μ A f =
      ∑ i, (μ (A ∩ C i)).toReal / (μ A).toReal *
        normalizedRestrictedIntegral μ (A ∩ C i) f

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.eventCondExp_mono_ae

Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.eventCondExp_smul
statement:
lemma eventCondExp_smul (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Set Ω) (c : ℝ) (g : Ω → ℝ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.eventCondExp_sub
statement:
lemma eventCondExp_sub (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Set Ω)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.indepFun_of_boundedTestFactorization
statement:
theorem indepFun_of_boundedTestFactorization

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.FiniteMarkovPerturbation.stochastic_moment_error
statement:
lemma stochastic_moment_error {S : Type*} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    {P Q : Matrix S S ℝ} (hP : IsStochasticMatrix P) (hQ : IsStochasticMatrix Q)
    {p q r s : S → ℝ} (hp : IsProbabilityVector p) (hq : IsProbabilityVector q)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {εν εP εr : ℝ}
    (hpq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, |p i - q i| ≤ εν)
    (hPQ : ∀ i, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j, |P i j - Q i j| ≤ εP)
    (hrs : ∀ i, |r i - s i| ≤ εr) (k : Nat) :
    |(∑ i, (Matrix.vecMul p (P ^ k)) i * r i) -
      ∑ i, (Matrix.vecMul q (Q ^ k)) i * s i| ≤ εν + (k : ℝ) * εP + εr

statement:

    {r s : S → ℝ} (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {εP εr : ℝ}
    (hPQ : ∀ i, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j, |P i j - Q i j| ≤ εP)
    (hrs : ∀ i, |r i - s i| ≤ εr) (k : Nat) :
    ∀ i, |((P ^ k).mulVec r) i - ((Q ^ k).mulVec s) i| ≤
      (k : ℝ) * εP + εr

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.FiniteMarkovPerturbation.stochastic_power_reward_unit
statement:

        ((∫ r, gaussianWeightedMonomial (2 * k + 2) r ∂μ) -

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.deriv_hermite_succ
statement:
theorem deriv_hermite_succ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun y : ℝ => (aeval y (hermite (n + 1)) : ℝ)) x =
      (n + 1 : ℝ) * aeval x (hermite n)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.derivative_hermite_succ
statement:
theorem derivative_hermite_succ (n : ℕ) :
    derivative (hermite (n + 1)) = C (n + 1 : ℤ) * hermite n

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.gaussianPDFReal_standard
statement:
theorem gaussianPDFReal_standard (x : ℝ) :
    gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x =
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2 / 2))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.hasDerivAt_hermite_succ
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_hermite_succ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (aeval y (hermite (n + 1)) : ℝ))
      ((n + 1 : ℝ) * aeval x (hermite n)) x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.hasDerivAt_standardGaussianWeight
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_standardGaussianWeight (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-(y ^ 2 / 2)))
      (-x * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2 / 2))) x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.hermite_eval_succ
statement:
theorem hermite_eval_succ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (aeval x (hermite (n + 1)) : ℝ) =
      x * aeval x (hermite n) - aeval x (derivative (hermite n))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integrable_eval_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integrable_eval_gaussianReal (p : ℝ[X]) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => p.eval x) (gaussianReal 0 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integrable_eval_mul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_eval_mul_gaussian (p : ℝ[X]) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => p.eval x * Real.exp (-b * x ^ 2))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integrable_hermite_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_hermite_mul (j k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (aeval x (hermite j) : ℝ) * aeval x (hermite k))
      (gaussianReal 0 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integral_gaussianReal_standard
statement:
theorem integral_gaussianReal_standard (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * ∫ x, f x * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2 / 2))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integral_hermite_mul
statement:
theorem integral_hermite_mul (j k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, (aeval x (hermite j) : ℝ) * aeval x (hermite k) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      if j = k then (Nat.factorial j : ℝ) else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integral_hermite_succ
statement:
theorem integral_hermite_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, (aeval x (hermite (n + 1)) : ℝ) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integral_hermite_succ_mul_succ
statement:
theorem integral_hermite_succ_mul_succ (j k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, (aeval x (hermite (j + 1)) : ℝ) * aeval x (hermite (k + 1))
      ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      (k + 1 : ℝ) * ∫ x, (aeval x (hermite j) : ℝ) * aeval x (hermite k)
        ∂gaussianReal 0 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integral_mul_eval_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integral_mul_eval_gaussianReal (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (∫ x, x * p.eval x ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      ∫ x, p.derivative.eval x ∂gaussianReal 0 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integral_mul_eval_mul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_mul_eval_mul_gaussian (p : ℝ[X]) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, (x * p.eval x) * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2 / 2))) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, p.derivative.eval x * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2 / 2))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.tendsto_eval_mul_gaussian_cocompact
statement:
theorem tendsto_eval_mul_gaussian_cocompact (p : ℝ[X]) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => p.eval x * Real.exp (-b * x ^ 2))
      (cocompact ℝ) (𝓝 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.coeff_hermite_div_factorial
statement:
theorem coeff_hermite_div_factorial (m k : ℕ) :
    ((hermite (2 * m + k)).coeff k : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial (2 * m + k) : ℝ) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ m /
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial k : ℝ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.hasSum_even_expSeries
Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.hermite_eval_div_factorial
statement:
theorem hermite_eval_div_factorial (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    (aeval z (hermite n) : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial n : ℝ) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n / 2 + 1),
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ m * z ^ (n - 2 * m) /
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial (n - 2 * m) : ℝ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.summable_norm_even_expSeries
statement:
theorem summable_norm_even_expSeries (u : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖if Even n then
      u ^ (n / 2) / (Nat.factorial (n / 2) : ℝ) else 0‖)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.card_patterns_with_image_le
statement:
theorem card_patterns_with_image_le (S T : Finset α) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 8 => S)).filter
      (fun a => patternImage a = T)).card ≤ T.card ^ 8

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.choose_sum_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem choose_sum_le_polynomial (m : ℕ) (v : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 4, (m.choose k : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ 8 * v ^ k) ≤
      (m : ℝ) * v + 128 * ((m : ℝ) * v) ^ 2 +
        1094 * ((m : ℝ) * v) ^ 3 + 2731 * ((m : ℝ) * v) ^ 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.cube_le_self_add_fourth
statement: theorem cube_le_self_add_fourth (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : t ^ 3 ≤ t + t ^ 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.patternImage_card_bounds
statement:
theorem patternImage_card_bounds (a : Fin 8 → α) (ha : NoSingleton a) :
    1 ≤ (patternImage a).card ∧ (patternImage a).card ≤ 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.polynomial_le_factorial
statement:
theorem polynomial_le_factorial (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    t + 128 * t ^ 2 + 1094 * t ^ 3 + 2731 * t ^ 4 ≤
      (Nat.factorial 8 : ℝ) * (t ^ 4 + t)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.sq_le_self_add_fourth
statement: theorem sq_le_self_add_fourth (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : t ^ 2 ≤ t + t ^ 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.weighted_survivingPatterns_le
statement:
theorem weighted_survivingPatterns_le (S : Finset α) (v : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    (∑ a ∈ survivingPatterns S, v ^ (patternImage a).card) ≤
      (Nat.factorial 8 : ℝ) * (((S.card : ℝ) * v) ^ 4 + (S.card : ℝ) * v)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.weighted_survivingPatterns_le_choose_sum
statement:
theorem weighted_survivingPatterns_le_choose_sum (S : Finset α) (v : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    (∑ a ∈ survivingPatterns S, v ^ (patternImage a).card) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 4, (S.card.choose k : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ 8 * v ^ k

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.abs_centered_mark_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_centered_mark_le_one (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (h0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) (h1 : ∀ y, f y ≤ 1)
    (y : Ω) : |f y - ∫ z, f z ∂μ| ≤ 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.abs_integral_centered_pow_le_variance
statement:
theorem abs_integral_centered_pow_le_variance (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (h0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) (h1 : ∀ y, f y ≤ 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    |∫ y, (f y - ∫ z, f z ∂μ) ^ n ∂μ| ≤ variance f μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.abs_integral_pow_le_secondMoment
statement:
theorem abs_integral_pow_le_secondMoment (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    |∫ y, g y ^ n ∂μ| ≤ ∫ y, g y ^ 2 ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.integrable_pow_of_abs_le_one
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem integrable_pow_of_abs_le_one (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.integral_centered_mark_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_centered_mark_eq_zero (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (h0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) (h1 : ∀ y, f y ≤ 1) :
    (∫ y, (f y - ∫ z, f z ∂μ) ∂μ) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.mean_mem_unitInterval
statement:
theorem mean_mem_unitInterval (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (h0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) (h1 : ∀ y, f y ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ (∫ y, f y ∂μ) ∧ (∫ y, f y ∂μ) ≤ 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.abs_integral_pattern_le
statement:
theorem abs_integral_pattern_le (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hb : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1)
    (a : Fin 8 → ι) (ha : NoSingleton a) :
    |∫ x : ι → Ω, (∏ j : Fin 8, g (x (a j))) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)| ≤
      (∫ y, g y ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (patternImage a).card

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.integrable_pattern
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem integrable_pattern (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hb : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1) (a : Fin 8 → ι) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω => ∏ j : Fin 8, g (x (a j)))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.integral_pattern_eq_zero_of_singleton
statement:
theorem integral_pattern_eq_zero_of_singleton (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hcenter : (∫ y, g y ∂μ) = 0)
    (a : Fin 8 → ι) (r : ι) (hr : multiplicity a r = 1) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, (∏ j : Fin 8, g (x (a j))) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.integral_pattern_factorization
statement:
theorem integral_pattern_factorization (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (a : Fin 8 → ι) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, (∏ j : Fin 8, g (x (a j))) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)) =
      ∏ r : ι, ∫ y, g y ^ multiplicity a r ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.centered_sum_eighth_moment_le
statement:
theorem centered_sum_eighth_moment_le (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hb : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1)
    (hcenter : (∫ y, g y ∂μ) = 0) (S : Finset ι) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, (∑ r ∈ S, g (x r)) ^ 8 ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)) ≤
      (Nat.factorial 8 : ℝ) *
        (((S.card : ℝ) * (∫ y, g y ^ 2 ∂μ)) ^ 4 +
          (S.card : ℝ) * (∫ y, g y ^ 2 ∂μ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.iid_centered_bounded_sum_eighth_moment
statement:
theorem iid_centered_bounded_sum_eighth_moment (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (h0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) (h1 : ∀ y, f y ≤ 1)
    (S : Finset ι) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, (∑ r ∈ S, (f (x r) - ∫ y, f y ∂μ)) ^ 8
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)) ≤
      (Nat.factorial 8 : ℝ) *
        (((S.card : ℝ) * variance f μ) ^ 4 + (S.card : ℝ) * variance f μ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.integral_eighth_sum_eq_pattern_sum
statement:
theorem integral_eighth_sum_eq_pattern_sum (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hb : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1) (S : Finset ι) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, (∑ r ∈ S, g (x r)) ^ 8 ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)) =
      ∑ a ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 8 => S),
        ∫ x : ι → Ω, (∏ j : Fin 8, g (x (a j))) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.IdentDistrib.EighthMoment.integral_eighth_sum_le_survivors
statement:
theorem integral_eighth_sum_le_survivors (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hb : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1)
    (hcenter : (∫ y, g y ∂μ) = 0) (S : Finset ι) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, (∑ r ∈ S, g (x r)) ^ 8 ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)) ≤
      ∑ a ∈ survivingPatterns S, (∫ y, g y ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (patternImage a).card

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.ConvergingTogether.integral_abs_le_sqrt_integral_sq
statement:
theorem integral_abs_le_sqrt_integral_sq (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (f : Ω → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 μ) :
    ∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ∂μ ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂μ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.ConvergingTogether.norm_cexp_mul_I_sub_cexp_mul_I_le
statement:
theorem norm_cexp_mul_I_sub_cexp_mul_I_le (a b : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp (a * Complex.I) - Complex.exp (b * Complex.I)‖ ≤ |a - b|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.ConvergingTogether.norm_charFun_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_charFun_sub_le (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {S T : Ω → ℝ} (hS : AEMeasurable S μ) (hT : AEMeasurable T μ)
    (hint : Integrable (fun ω => S ω - T ω) μ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖charFun (μ.map S) t - charFun (μ.map T) t‖
      ≤ |t| * ∫ ω, |S ω - T ω| ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.ConvergingTogether.norm_charFun_sub_le_L2
statement:
theorem norm_charFun_sub_le_L2 (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {S T : Ω → ℝ} (hS : AEMeasurable S μ) (hT : AEMeasurable T μ)
    (hdiff : MemLp (fun ω => S ω - T ω) 2 μ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖charFun (μ.map S) t - charFun (μ.map T) t‖
      ≤ |t| * Real.sqrt (∫ ω, (S ω - T ω) ^ 2 ∂μ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_average_integral
statement:
lemma iid_average_integral
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (F : Ω → ℝ) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    (∫ sample : Fin m → Ω,
        (m : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, F (sample i)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => μ)) =

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_average_integral_fintype
statement:
lemma iid_average_integral_fintype
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (F : Ω → ℝ) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    (∫ sample : ι → Ω,
        (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, F (sample i)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)) =

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_average_variance
statement:
lemma iid_average_variance
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (m : ℕ)
    (F : Ω → ℝ) (hF : MemLp F 2 μ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.variance
        (fun sample : Fin m → Ω =>
          (m : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, F (sample i))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => μ)) =
      (m : ℝ)⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.variance F μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_average_variance_fintype
statement:
lemma iid_average_variance_fintype
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (F : Ω → ℝ) (hF : MemLp F 2 μ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.variance
        (fun sample : ι → Ω =>
          (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, F (sample i))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => μ)) =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.variance F μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_mean_abs_le
statement:
theorem iid_mean_abs_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (ξ : Ω → ℝ) (hξ : MemLp ξ 2 μ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_mean_abs_le_fintype
statement:
theorem iid_mean_abs_le_fintype {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]

        ∂(Measure.pi fun _ : ι => μ) ≤

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_mean_euclidean_abs_le
statement:
theorem iid_mean_euclidean_abs_le {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_mean_euclidean_abs_le_fintype
statement:

    {Ω ι κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] [Fintype κ]

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_mean_sq_le

theorem iid_mean_sq_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.iid_mean_sq_le_fintype
statement:
theorem iid_mean_sq_le_fintype {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integrable_euclidean_of_integrable
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem integrable_euclidean_of_integrable
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] {μ : Measure Ω}

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.integrable_iid_mean_euclidean
statement:
theorem integrable_iid_mean_euclidean {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {n : ℕ}
    (ξ : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ k, Integrable (ξ k) μ) :
    Integrable (fun s => Real.sqrt (∑ k : ι,
        ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ i : Fin n, ξ k (s i)) - ∫ ω, ξ k ω ∂μ) ^ 2))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.memLp_two_iid_mean_euclidean

theorem memLp_two_iid_mean_euclidean {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι]

    (ξ : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ k, MemLp (ξ k) 2 μ) :
    MemLp (fun s => Real.sqrt (∑ k : ι,
        ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ i : Fin n, ξ k (s i)) - ∫ ω, ξ k ω ∂μ) ^ 2)) 2
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.memLp_two_iid_mean_euclidean_fintype
statement:

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Independence.Conditional.condExp_mul_of_condIndep
statement:
theorem condExp_mul_of_condIndep
    {Ω α β : Type*}
    {m mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [StandardBorelSpace Ω]
    {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f : Ω → α} {g : Ω → β}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hCI : ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun m hm f g μ)
    {u : α → ℝ} {v : β → ℝ} (hu : Measurable u) (hv : Measurable v)
    (huf : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => u (f ω)) μ)
    (hvg : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => v (g ω)) μ)
    (huv : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => u (f ω) * v (g ω)) μ) :
    μ[fun ω => u (f ω) * v (g ω) | m]
      =ᵐ[μ] (μ[fun ω => u (f ω) | m]) * (μ[fun ω => v (g ω) | m])

statement:

    {Ω α β : Type*}

    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [StandardBorelSpace Ω]
    {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f : Ω → α} {g : Ω → β}

    (hCI : ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun m hm g f μ)
    {S A F : Set Ω}

    ∫ x in A ∩ F, (μ[S.indicator (fun _ : Ω => c) | m]) x ∂μ =
      ∫ x in A ∩ F, S.indicator (fun _ : Ω => c) x ∂μ

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Probability.Independence.Conditional.condIndep_valuesProjection_contraction
statement:
theorem condIndep_valuesProjection_contraction
    {M : Type*} [DecidableEq M]
    {I X Y W Z : Finset M}
    {Ω : M → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (Ω n)]
    [StandardBorelSpace (ValuesOn I Ω)]
    (hX : X ⊆ I) (hY : Y ⊆ I) (hW : W ⊆ I)
    (hZ : Z ⊆ I)
    {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (ValuesOn I Ω)} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (h1 :
      ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun
        (MeasurableSpace.comap
          (valuesProjection (Ω := Ω) (Finset.union_subset hZ hW)) inferInstance)
        (comap_valuesProjection_le (Ω' := Ω) (Finset.union_subset hZ hW))
        (valuesProjection (Ω := Ω) hX)
        (valuesProjection (Ω := Ω) hY)
        μ)
    (h2 :
      ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun
        (MeasurableSpace.comap (valuesProjection (Ω := Ω) hZ) inferInstance)
        (comap_valuesProjection_le (Ω' := Ω) hZ)
        (valuesProjection (Ω := Ω) hX)
        (valuesProjection (Ω := Ω) hW)
        μ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun
      (MeasurableSpace.comap (valuesProjection (Ω := Ω) hZ) inferInstance)
      (comap_valuesProjection_le (Ω' := Ω) hZ)
      (valuesProjection (Ω := Ω) hX)
      (valuesProjection (Ω := Ω) (Finset.union_subset hY hW))
      μ

    [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω']
    (r : Ω → Ω') (hr : Measurable r)
    {μ : Measure Ω} {μ' : Measure Ω'}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure μ']
    (hmap_r : Measure.map r μ = μ')
    (m : MeasurableSpace Ω') (hm : m ≤ mΩ')
